articleTitle: Research on Individual Recognition and Matching of Whale and Dolphin Based on EfficientNet Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Due to the particularity and complexity of the marine environment, the identification and detection of marine organisms has been the focus of researchers all over the world. In recent years, with the rapid development of marine biological imaging technology and biometric recognition technology, it is possible to recognize and match individual organisms, such as fingerprint and face recognition has been widely used. In this paper, a retrieval model combining EfficientNet and Additive Angular Margin loss function is proposed to track individual whales and dolphins over time. In the process of data preprocessing, the key feature parts are trimmed by YOLOV5 model, and the data set is supplemented by geometric transformation and color transformation. Experimental result show that EfficientNet B6 model achieves the best performance, while ensuring the accuracy, the operation efficiency is relatively high. Specifically, the MAP@5 value of EfficientNet-B6 model matching result is 0.768, which is 1.59% and 1.05% higher than EfficientNet-B0 and EfficientNet-B5, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on fire detection based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Fire is a frequent and hugely harmful disaster accident in people's daily life, which will seriously threaten people's life and property safety. Therefore, fire detection is very important in safety inspection, and people can effectively reduce losses based on early warning. Traditional fire detection methods have obvious limitations, such as temperature detectors, smoke detectors, thermal cameras, etc. These devices are often expensive, vulnerable, inaccurate, and prone to excessive false positives. In recent years, human beings have entered a highly information age. Fire detection technology based on computer vision has begun to enter people's field of vision, especially the rapid development of deep learning provides a new direction for fire detection. In recent years, human beings have entered a highly information age. Fire detection and monitoring platforms based on UAV technology, 5G technology, ultra-broadband transmission technology, and high-speed Internet of Things technology are more and more widely used. Although this solves the problem of the data transmission rate, the detection performance of the terminal needs to be improved. Fire detection technology based on computer vision has begun to enter people's field of vision, especially the rapid development of deep learning provides a new direction for fire detection. This paper first analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of four commonly used deep learning-based target detection algorithms, then uses the latest YOLOv5 target detection algorithm for experiments, and finally uses PyQT5 to make a fire detection system demo. The experimental results show that fire detection based on YOLOv5 can achieve better detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Robot Inspection System in Power Transmission Project
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Nowadys, ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the power grid and building a strong and smart grid has become the focus of power work. However, the current preventive inspections and on-site inspections have been difficult to satisfy the real-time power grid. Monitoring and early warning requirements. With the vigorous advancement of the construction of the ubiquitous power Internet of Things, the continuous innovation in the field of artificial intelligence technology, the use of new technologies such as image recognition to promote the development of power transmission inspection business has become a major issue in the power grid industry in recent years. This research conducted a systematic review and analysis of the intelligent inspection work of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Remote sensing building change detection based on improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of detail information loss caused by feature misalignment caused by deconvolution in building change detection of remote sensing image, a siamese neural network remote sensing building change detection algorithm based on U-Net improvement is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm improves the encoder part, changing the convolutional neural coding network with single image input to the convolutional neural coding network with double image input. Secondly, the feature extraction part with residual structure is replaced by the feature extraction part of U-NET. Finally improve decoding structure, based on the characteristics between adjacent layers figure characteristics of semantic change flow direction into alignment module, to modify the characteristics of high-level figure, reduce on the loss of the details of the sampling, form a model of the end-to-end change detection. Experimental results show that the Precision, Recall, F1, OA and MIOU of the proposed algorithm reach 89.03%, 93.69%, 91.30%, 99.14% and 84.00% respectively on the LEVIR_CD building change data set. The improved algorithm effectively improves the accuracy of building change detection.

articleTitle: RSSI-Based Indoor Localization Using Sparrow Search Algorithm and Backward Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Traditional localization algorithms based on received signal strength indication (RSSI) construct ranging model through the log-normal shadowing model, in which the parameters are usually chosen empirically and therefore sensitive to the influence of environments. In this paper, an indoor localization method based on sparrow search algorithm (SSA) and backward propagation (BP) neural network is proposed to construct the ranging model. In the proposed SSA-BP method, the collected RSSI values are firstly processed by Gaussian filtering and then input into the SSA-BP neural network to construct the ranging model, which can output distance values between the target nodes (TN) and anchor nodes. Finally, the TN's position can be estimated by using the maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) method. Simulation results show that compared with the existing BP algorithm and genetic algorithm (GA), the proposed SSA-BP algorithm has faster convergence speed and higher positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on clustering algorithms in data mining
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Clustering is a necessary data pre-processing method in data mining research, which aims to obtain the intrinsic distribution structure of valuable datasets from unlabeled datasets and thus simplify the description of the datasets. Data mining technology can discover potential and valuable knowledge from a large amount of data, giving a new meaning to the massive amount of data accumulated by people in the information age—new meaning. With the rapid development of data mining technology, as an essential part of it, grid clustering technology has been widely used in data analysis images. As a mainstream data mining method, cluster analysis facilitates data processing in machine learning by implementing clustering algorithms to analyze data and the proper operation of machines. Through the continuous experiments and proofs of previous generations, the algorithms on cluster analysis are becoming more and more mature. The text lists an overview of the evolution of high-quality clustering algorithms to understand the applications better and explore multiple clustering approaches. This study reviews papers that refer to 16 more well-known and research-discussed developmental academic articles to understand their applications on clustering and explore the development of clustering in various fields. This systematic review aims to summarize the cluster analysis and grouping techniques used to date and make recommendations for future developments.

articleTitle: Multilingual Toxic Text Classification Model Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The nature of comments usually has an important impact on the network environment. Polite and gentle comments can not only promote communication between users, but also maintain the stability of the network platform. On the contrary, rude and toxic comments will make the communication environment unacceptable. Therefore, we need to impose certain restrictions on comments. This article is based on the XLM-RoBERTa model to achieve the classification of multilingual toxic comments. We first use training and verification data to train and optimize the model, and then use the test data to get the final classification results. In addition, our model is compared with models such as LSTM and RNN. Experiments show that the model proposed in this paper has better classification performance.

articleTitle: Towards Real-Time Visual Tracking in Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper presents a robust and real-time target detection and tracking method under the framework of Meanshift for autonomous robot applications. Meanshift, because of its simplicity and efficiency, has been widely used in tracking tasks, especially in embedded environments. But, the traditional MS algorithm can be effective only when the target regions located in the previous frame are very similar to the candidate regions of the current frame. Therefore, the tracking performance will deteriorate when the target moves fast, or the target is blocked, because at this time, the overlapping area in the image will be greatly reduced. In this paper, we integrate the background models and the graded color features of moving targets to solve the above challenges. In addition, our method is tested on 10 video streams with different scenarios on the ARMv7 platform. Experimental results show the effectiveness of this method in the above scenarios.

articleTitle: Stock volatility prediction Using TabNet based deep learning method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The significant feature of stock market maturity is stock volatility. Moreover, volatility is central determinant of market price behavior, so investigating the characteristics of stock market volatility is conducive to comprehend the price behavior of the stock market. In-depth study of the factors of stock market volatility will help investors make rational investments and promote the long-term health and stability of the national economy. With the development of sophisticated intelligent algorithms, machine learning methods are able to facilitate stock volatility prediction by effectively extracting features associated with core objectives. Based on the highly nonlinear stock market and the discrete nature of market data, this paper proposes a TabNet-based stock volatility prediction method. This method can encode discrete data and decrease model over-parameterization compared to traditional machine learning methods. Experiments confirm that this method has better performance than several classic machine learning algorithms, and with RMSPE as the evaluation index, the performance on the stock volatility dataset surpasses classic machine learning algorithms such as Naive Bayes and Xgboost.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis of Talent Portraits Based on K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of power communication infrastructure and the further refinement and precision of power system business information, the power system platform generates and stores a large amount of talent information and business data in the management process. Human resource management has become a critical task. Due to many ideological and technical limitations in the past, talent management methods can't meet the talent management needs of today's colossal power system, which seriously affects the promotion, application, popularization, and development of the talent management model in the new era. Therefore, this paper is mainly based on the demand response research of talent portrait characteristics of power companies. Firstly, this paper uses data mining theory and clustering analysis method to extract and analyze the occupational characteristics of employees in power companies and discusses the clustering application of the K-means algorithm in high-dimensional data such as talents, skills, and technical majors. Then, on this basis, the improved K-means algorithm is introduced, the improved K-means algorithm is put forward, and its effectiveness in talent occupation clustering is verified. Finally, through the cluster analysis of talents' occupations in electric power companies, this paper extracts and classifies the characteristics of talents' professional abilities and puts forward a talent-side interactive response strategy method based on the characteristics of talents' portraits in electric power companies.

articleTitle: Research on gesture recognition based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of 5G, artificial intelligence, and Internet of Things technologies, smart digital home have entered thousands of households, which made our lives colorful. As a kind of human-computer interaction (HCI), gesture has the characteristics of strong information expression ability and transmission function, non-contact, and simple and easy to understand, which has been widely used in robot control, virtual reality, intelligent driving, and somatosensory games. The initial interaction method of gesture was through external hardware such as digital gloves, biological myoelectricity, and Kinect depth equipment, and then gradually developed into a method based on computer vision algorithms. The rapid development of deep learning in recent years has greatly improved the performance of image recognition and provided a new direction for gesture recognition. The deep learning method based on convolutional neural network can automatically extract image features, and is less affected by image background factors, which greatly improves the recognition accuracy. With the development of target detection technology, some algorithms have been increasing the depth of the network to obtain higher recognition accuracy, which will lead to excessive computing resource and high hardware requirements. Complex neural networks slow down the model recognition rate and are difficult to apply to resource-constrained mobile and embedded devices. This paper introduces the overall structure of the YOLOv5 network. The model is trained by YOLOv5s network and validated by real gesture. Finally, a gesture recognition software demo is made by PyQT5. The experimental results show that gesture recognition based on YOLOv5 can achieve better recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Readmission prediction of diabetic patients based on AdaBoost-RandomForest mixed model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Readmission rates have become one of the indicators used to evaluate health care systems in many countries. It is a huge waste of healthcare and financial resources. Therefore, researchers have been studying how to reduce readmission rates. After an in-depth study, a hybrid Adaboost-RandomForest model approach is proposed to predict the readmission risk of diabetic patients. Fisrtly, RandomUnderSampler technique is used to solve imbalance problem. Then AdaBoost model is trained and its predictions are merged into the original dataset as new features, and the model of RandomForest is trained and tested with the new dataset. The results show that the hybrid model proposed in this paper achieves 0.79, 0.78 and 0.78 in terms of precision, recall and AUC, respectively, outperforming single algorithm models such as Naive Bayes, Tabnet, decision tree and KNN. This paper also uses the interpretability of machine learning to obtain a feature importance analysis graph, explaining the reasons for the formation of decisions. Good results from hybrid models and importance analysis plots can help physicians improve treatment planning and length of hospital stay, which can reduce readmission rates.

articleTitle: A novel campus fire monitoring system based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To protect lives and equipment, a robust, reliable, and expandable fire monitoring system is critical to detect and react in a campus fire situation. Thus, this paper proposes a YOLOv5-based campus fire monitoring system directly deployable on existing terminals, computers, and other IoT terminals. The proposed campus fire monitoring system effectively monitoring fires in various scenarios on campus all day long. Our deep learning model has been trained using fire images and fire scene videos. The experimental evaluations on different end devices demonstrate that our system achieves an appealing performance in campus fire monitoring.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ship shore power data analysis system based on Doris data warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Ship shore power technology is an effective means to achieve energy conservation and emission reduction for water transportation. In order to ensure the scientific usage of ship shore power and optimize the layout of ship shore power piles, a ship shore power data analysis system based on the Doris data warehouse technology is designed and implemented. This system can realize a real-time data statistics and query based on Doris. It realizes the visual display based on the back-end and front-end separation technology. The front-end requests data through Axios, and the back-end returns the query data with the JSON format. Maps and charts are displayed based on the Echarts and Mapbox tools. The system has been applied in the maritime supervision, and provided the data support for the decision-making of ship shore power management.

articleTitle: MPC-Based Privacy-Preserving Serverless Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple users to collaboratively train a global model by keeping their data sets local. Since a single server is used, traditional FL faces the single point of failure problem. An available approach is to adopt a serverless architecture. However, most of existing serverless FL schemes fail to protect gradient privacy, except for a few schemes that adopt differential privacy (DP) where the global model accuracy will decrease. To address these problems, we propose a privacy-preserving serverless FL scheme based on secure multiparty computation (MPC). Combining multiple cryptographic primitives (e.g., key agreement and symmetric encryption), our scheme protects gradient privacy in FL and it is accuracy-lossless. By secret sharing, our scheme supports users to quit an FL task in each round during training.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection System for the Internet of Things Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The growing applications of the Internet of Things (IoT) technologies have led to enormous security problems. Since Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) based on Machine Learning (ML) techniques have a powerful capability in detecting intrusion, especially zero-day attacks, this domain has gained great attention from researchers. In this paper, we use a newly published IoT dataset, the TON_IoT network dataset, to build an IoT IDS. After comparing ten ML algorithms and comprehensive consideration, we choose the XGBoost method as the ultimate classifier. Experiments show that our model can achieve an MCC of 99.84% and 99.17% in binary and multiclass classifications, respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Edge Computing in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The development of the Internet of Things has promoted the development of smart grids. Edge computing, as one of the key technologies for Internet of Things applications, provides data services at the edge of the system through the integration of network, storage, computing and other technologies to solve the problem of real-time processing of a large amount of data. This paper focuses on the analysis of how edge computing technology is combined with power grid services. The article first analyzes the key technologies and characteristics of edge computing, and finally discusses the application of edge computing in smart grids.

articleTitle: Discrete Baby Search Algorithm for Combinatorial Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems widely exist in many real-world engineering projects and artificial intelligence applications. There are many effective methods to deal with combinatorial optimization problems, of which the approaches based on evolutionary algorithms are a generally used class of methods. We proposed a novelty fabulous evolutionary algorithm called Baby Search Algorithm (BSA) which simulates the behavior of infants searching for interesting toys. BSA has a powerful ability to balance exploration and exploitation, but it is designed for handling continuous optimization issues. We develop a variant of BSA named Discrete Baby Search Algorithm (DBSA) for handling combinatorial optimization problems in this paper. There are two versions of the DBSA, one using constant value binarization strategy and the other using function discretization strategy. Besides, DBSA introduces an interesting factor to advance its performance. We take feature selection as the testing problem, and use six binary classification datasets with six classic methods to evaluate DBSA. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition Method Based on DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Under the statistical mode, underwater acoustic target recognition relies on heavy feature engineering, and the manually extracted features are sometimes not necessarily effective. At the same time, for confidentiality reasons, the lack of underwater acoustic data will also seriously affect the performance of the underwater acoustic target recognition system. In view of the above problems, the convolutional neural network, residual neural network and densely connected convolutional neural network are introduced and improved, and a Res-DenseNet-based network model is proposed and applied to the underwater acoustic target recognition task. An experimental study was carried out on the dataset. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional method of MFCC+SVM, using the ResNet network alone and the DenseNet network alone, the correct recognition rates of the new model proposed in this paper are increased by 9.48%, 5.09% and 5.06%, respectively. The method in this paper can be effectively used for underwater acoustic target recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Electrical Parameter Fault Diagnosis Method of Oil Well Based on TSC-DCGAN Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Due to the wide distribution and large number of oil Wells, it is extremely difficult to obtain oil well data, and the lack of electrical parameter data samples greatly restricts the development of intelligent diagnosis technology of oil well working conditions based on electrical parameters. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on time series transformation generative adversation network (TSC-DCGAN). Firstly, on the basis of analyzing the normal and typical fault working mechanism of rod pump, the simulation model of the whole process of mechanical production system is established, and the electrical parameter data for oil well fault diagnosis is generated, valuable data sets of real oil well electrical parameters are obtained. Secondly, in view of the limited data category generated by the mechanism model, the method of TSC-DCGAN is used to expand the electrical parameter data. Finally, a variety of deep learning network models are used to classificy the extended electrical parameter data. The EfficientNet deep learning network achieved the best classification effect, with an accuracy of more than 0.95. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective, and we hope this method can promote the development of oil well intelligent diagnosis technology.

articleTitle: Research on YOLOv5 Vehicle Object Detection Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In intelligent transportation systems, the study of vehicle object detection is of great importance. In order to improve the performance of object detection, an improved method based on YOLOv5 is used for vehicle object detection, and a YOLOv5x vehicle multi-object detection optimization algorithm based on attention mechanism is proposed by adding attention mechanism modules to different modules of the network for network optimization, and the algorithm is validated on the traffic dataset constructed in the paper to show the feasibility of the improved strategy. According to the experimental results, it can be seen that the improved detection algorithm improves the mAP by more than 10% compared with the original detection algorithm, which is better than the original detection algorithm.

articleTitle: SAR Image Ship Detection Algorithm based on Machine Vision YOLO Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the detection technology of tiny size ship targets in SAR images based on the deep learning method. Firstly, the feature extraction network structure is redesigned to solve the problem that the feature information of small and medium-sized targets in SAR images is easily lost. Then, the path enhancement method is used to enrich the geometric position information in the high-level feature graph, and the fusion of adjacent feature graphs is used to enrich the expression ability of the feature graph. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by experiments, and the detection results in some typical scenarios are shown and compared with the classical target detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on temporal and spatial feature extraction and distribution prediction of the population in Lujiazui Financial & Trade Zone based on heat map
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Considering the densely populated area of Lujiazui Financial & Trade Zone, we propose a population temporal and spatial distribution model based on heat map The collected spatiotemporal heat data are analyzed according to the distribution characteristics of time domain (statistical domain) and space domain (statistical domain) we propose four eigenvalues: total number, maximum, standard deviation and average for stationary and periodic analysis, and extract the feature vector in time domain through MLP. In spatial domain, we propose three different sizes of convolution to convolute spatiotemporal data to extract spatial feature vectors. Through the attention mechanism, the characteristics of time domain and space domain are fused by the weight of autonomous learning, and the spatio-temporal characteristics are obtained. A three-layer convolution neural network based on spatiotemporal fusion characteristics is constructed to predict the spatiotemporal distribution of population heat. After experiments, the model proposed in this paper is lower than other baseline models in error level. According to the attention weight of spatio-temporal features, the following conclusions are drawn: (1) in the time-domain features, the maximum and average can best represent the time-domain features. (2) in the spatial domain features, the larger the scale of convolution kernel, the better the prediction effect. (3) the periodicity of time-domain can be used as the time window of convolution.

articleTitle: EEG-based tonic cold pain intensity assessment using CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Pain has gradually become a problem that plagues human beings, to objectively identify different levels of pain in brain activity signals, this paper has designed a cold tenderness experiment to obtain acute pain signals, and the pre-treated signals have been analyzed by a deep learning network model to identify four levels of pain signals, and the classification accuracy reached 87.67%. It has been proven that deep learning models can effectively distinguish between different levels of pain signals.

articleTitle: NB-IoT-based Environmental Monitoring System for Peach Orchard
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To meet the monitoring of the peach growth environment, a narrowband IoT-based peach orchard environment monitoring system is proposed for the current problems of backward monitoring means and a low degree of informationization in peach industry planting. By using NB-IoT narrowband communication technology combined with connected microprocessor STM32, IoT cloud platform, and various sensors to design a deep coverage, strong connectivity, and low-cost peach orchard environment monitoring system, which effectively reduces the networking cost, and the designed system is field-tested in Feicheng City, Shandong Province. The system design optimizes the existing problems of remote monitoring of peach orchards in traditional planting, provides a reliable technical solution for intelligent planting of peach trees, and also provides decision support for efficient management of peach planters.

articleTitle: Radar signal recognition method based on Random Forest model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As a key step of electronic reconnaissance, radar signal recognition plays a decisive role in the deployment and control of electronic defense, electromagnetic interference attack and the formulation of operational plan. It is of great significance and research value for electromagnetic warfare and national defense security under modern information warfare. In order to identify the Platform Type of radar through various parameters of radar signal in the complex electromagnetic environment, this paper comprehensively analyzes the characteristics of radar signal and the development and evolution of relevant identification methods. Combined with the excellent performance of machine learning in classification and prediction, this paper deeply studies the process of model establishment, evaluation and optimization for Random Forest classification algorithm, and completes the process from algorithm programming to training and generating model to experimental test and verification. The experiment shows that after optimization, the prediction accuracy reaches 0.979, and the F1-score reaches 0.980, which provides an effective support for improving the efficiency of radar reconnaissance and early warning.

articleTitle: Construction of Fresh Agricultural Product Supply Chain Traceability Platform Based on Alliance Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of scattered data, information asymmetry, multi-source heterogeneity, and low security in the traceability system of agricultural product supply chain, this paper designs a fresh agricultural product data traceability platform based on the consortium blockchain, realizes the registration of multiple users and the storage of internal sensitive information through the blockchain smart contract technology, This platform designs a traceability structure based on the actual needs of the traceability system of the fresh agricultural product supply chain, and further ensures the safety and reliability of the transactions of all parties in the fresh agricultural product supply chain.

articleTitle: A GI Tract Image Segmentation Algorithm Via UNet 2.5D Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Digestive tract tumor is the most common malignant tumor, which seriously threatens human health. Therefore, there is an urgent need for the improvement of tumor treatment technology. With the development of computer science and technology and the innovation of hardware equipment, the research on computer aided diagnosis (CAD) [9] has been widely carried out. In our paper, we utilize U-Net2.5D for stomach and intestines’ segmentation, which could assist radiation oncologists to deliver high doses of radiation using X-ray beams pointed to tumors while avoiding the stomach and intestines. We choose dice similarity efficiency (DSC) as our experiment metrics. The higher DSC is, the more accuracy the segmentation will gain. The results show that our Unet2.5D(EfficientNetB1) owns the best performance with 0.841 DSC, which is 0.087, 0.093, 0.029 higher than Unet(ResNet50), Unet(EfficientNetB0) and Unet(EfficientNetB1) respectively.

articleTitle: Improved arithmetic optimization algorithm based on sigmoid function and Cauchy Gaussian fusion mutation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To solve the problems of arithmetic optimization algorithm (AOA) ,such as slow convergence speed, low convergence accuracy and easy to fall into local optimization, this dissertation put forward an improved arithmetic optimization algorithm (IAOA) which is improved by many methods. Firstly, the AOA population is initialized by tent chaotic map; Then, the mathematical optimizer acceleration function (MOA) is improved by using sigmoid function; Finally, the Cauchy Gauss fusion mutation strategy is used to mutate the current optimal individual, and the performance of IAOA is verified by the benchmark function. According to the experimental data, a prediction model (IAOA -SVM) for the quality index of finished pellets was established to predict the quality of finished pellets. The simulation results show that the prediction results of IAOA -SVM model are more accurate, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed IAOA in practical application.

articleTitle: Privacy Data Synchronization Method Based on Election in Intranet
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Privacy data synchronization is an important prerequisite for efficient data utilization on the intranet. Aiming at the lack of effective node election model and information synchronization mechanism in the current enterprise intranet, a privacy data synchronization model based on election is proposed. Firstly, the service cluster is generated according to the service type, and the cluster head election model is established to fairly identify the services in the cluster. Secondly, a privacy data synchronization method based on the heartbeat mechanism is designed. By establishing a communication channel with the central master service, the organizational structure information of all services in the cluster can be synchronized. The method proposed in this paper can realize the synchronization of privacy data safely and efficiently, and can be applied to the enterprise intranet.

articleTitle: YOLOv2-tiny Target Detection System Based on FPGA Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are increasingly used for target detection due to the development of deep learning. Currently, most CNNs are predominantly deployed on CPU and GPU platforms. Due to the restrictions of speed and power, it is difficult for the CPU and GPU-based CNN target identification system to match the needs of mobile scenarios. Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) may overcome the issues of complex target detection network architecture, extensive computation, and high storage overhead due to its high parallelism and low power consumption. So, an FPGA-based target detection system is designed in this paper. This study examines the network structure and data processing flow of the YOLOv2-Tiny model to lower the system's computing and resource needs by combining layers and employing 16-bit fixed-point quantization. In addition, a dual cache mechanism and a multi-channel transmission design are implemented to improve data storage and transfer. This YOLOv2-Tiny target detection system implemented using MZ7100 FPGA achieves a throughput of 47.33 GOPs at 150 MHz with batch processing while consuming 2.74 W of on-chip power and consumes 26.93 ms to recognize a single image frame. Compared with the Intel Core i5 CPU, the efficiency is 53 times. Although the recognition speed is not as fast as the GPU, the power consumption is significantly reduced, which meets the requirements for target recognition in embedded environments.

articleTitle: Research on network topology structure based on 5G+MESH ad hoc network technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The "5G+MESH" intelligent terminal equipment proposed in this paper has the characteristics of self-organization, self-robustness, low latency, high speed and large bandwidth, safety and reliability, etc. It can solve the communication service problems in areas with incomplete network signal coverage, combined with 5G access management Platform that provides low-cost, high-bandwidth, high-reliability voice, data, picture and video link solutions. This paper proposes intelligent frequency modulation, forwarding and routing technology. Each Mesh node has multiple radio frequency modules, which work in different frequency bands, which solves the problem of single Radio node sending and receiving co-channel interference. Each node automatically selects the best route to send or forward data packets, fully consider the performance of different RF modules/channels on each node, and take advantage of multiple frequency bands to improve network throughput and multi-hop performance and transmission stability sex. The characteristics of wireless transmission determine that its link packet loss rate cannot be the same as that of wired networks. However, due to the multi-hop characteristics of wireless MESH networks, the cost of packet loss and retransmission is amplified to some extent. Mesh intelligent forwarding technology adopts intelligent link retransmission strategy according to real-time network status, which effectively avoids retransmission caused by packet loss at the link layer and reduces the packet loss rate of multi-hop links. Mesh uses a multi-factor routing optimization algorithm to synthesize link information, node status, location, moving speed and other influencing factors to predict link status, effectively improve the self-recovery speed when the link fails, and achieve a more seamless mesh network connection. Mesh also adds a flexible routing management framework at the routing protocol layer. According to different application scenarios and business requirements, different routing algorithms and strategies can be loaded through simple deployment.

articleTitle: Mechanism Design and Gait Analysis of A Hexapod Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper introduces the relevant design and practice of bionic principle of hexapod robot based on STM32. We first design the foot and carry out inverse kinematics analysis of the foot. Then we take hierarchical control of the foot, and send coordinate value through serial interface to make the foot reach the specified coordinate position. At the same time, we plan the vertical triangular gait for the robot, and record the design process step by step, finally practice the design is completed on the prototype. The practical results show that the hexapod robot control system has certain execution and stability in the experimental environment, which can control the foot for multi-terrain adaptation and multi-action realization.

articleTitle: Remote sensing image classification based on attention mechanism and multi-scale features
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large change scale of remote sensing images and complex image backgrounds, which lead to poor classification of remote sensing scenes, a Multi-scale Convolution Block Attention Module(MS-CBAM) and an improved residual network-based remote sensing image classification method are proposed. Based on ResNet50, this method introduces multi-scale information into the residual structure and adds multi-scale convolution block attention module to improve the classification accuracy. The average classification accuracy on the public remote sensing image datasets UCMerced_LandUse and AID reached 94.10% and 93.52%. Compared with ResNet50, the classification accuracy was improved by 4.29% and 1.83%, respectively. Meanwhile, additional experiments verify the effectiveness of the multi-scale convolutional block attention module.

articleTitle: A High Performance JPEG Decoding Algorithm based on OPENCL
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: It is the solution of paralleled image decoding algorithm to address the issues of the decoding slowness and long latency for large size images in various applications. Base on JPEG decoding with high compression ratio, which widely used in various applications, this paper proposed the implementation of parallelized JPEG image decoding algorithm by using the OPENCL library. Obviously, the test results against large size images with the new algorithm demonstrated 4-5 times higher JPEG decoding performance than original decoding algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Shared Shopping Cart Based on Internet+
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to improve the shopping experience and shopping efficiency of offline supermarkets, an Intelligent Shared Shopping Cart Based on Internet+ is studied and designed. The intelligent shopping cart proposed in this paper is mainly based on computer vision, bluetooth positioning technology, share lease and other technologies to suggested a shopping car that can meet the needs of transportation in structure and can realize self service cashier, indoor positioning and navigation in function, using shared leasing as a shopping cart. This paper introduces the design scheme of each function of shopping cart. The test results show that the system can realize the functions ofmeet the needs of transportation in structure and can realize self service cashier, indoor positioning and navigation in function, using shared leasing and so on.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Motor based on Knowledge Graph and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the improvement of motor automation, the internal structure tends to be complex, and the approach of relying on traditional maintenance experience is too inefficient for fault diagnosis. The knowledge graph has natural semantic advantages, which provide the breakthrough for the relational representation of a large number of semantic knowledge information. Therefore, this paper designs the knowledge graph based on text data to complete the construction and storage of motor fault knowledge graphs. To address the problem that existing motor fault diagnosis methods rely on annotated data on a large scale in the auxiliary diagnosis process, and lack normative knowledge or expert experience. The motor fault diagnosis method (KG-CNN) based on the knowledge graph and convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed. Semantic and knowledge enrichment is achieved using the completed structured data constructed, and the fault feature vectors from the motor fault description text are fed into the CNN along with the corresponding knowledge feature vectors. Finally, several groups of motor fault text data are used to verify the effectiveness of KG-CNN in fault diagnosis performance. The results show that KG-CNN can improve the accuracy of the knowledge graph in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Defect detection method for key components of transmission line based on incremental learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of deep learning, how to use computer vision technology to accurately locate key components of transmission lines and identify defects in complex natural backgrounds has become a common problem faced by both academia and industry. Aiming at the problems of slow detection speed and high false detection rate in the existing defect detection methods of key components of transmission lines, a method for defect detection of key components of transmission lines based on incremental learning is proposed. First, a 34-layer ResNet network is used, two 3×3 convolutional networks are concatenated to form a residual network module, and Pytorch is used to build the ResNet network. Second, when training the network, the parameters of the pre-trained model ResNet34 are used as the initialization parameters of the classification network model. Then, after the training is completed, the network model is trained with a new set of data to obtain a model with incremental learning ability. Finally, the application verification is carried out in the inspection scheme of a power company’s transmission line above 110kV. The test results show that the method proposed in this paper can assist inspectors to quickly screening and locating defective bolts in high-resolution pictures to a certain extent, thereby significantly improving the work efficiency of the inspection process.

articleTitle: Spatial Line Entity Matching Technology for Spatial Association of Multi-source Vector Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Using geometric matching technology to establish the mapping association relationship between multi-source data is currently a research hotspot in the field of spatial association. The present study contributes to this field by proposing a method for matching spatial entities of multi-source vector data. The mapping relationship between spatial entities of multi-source data is obtained by geometric matching between line entities. Standard navigation data and OSM data of Shenzhen province were employed to validate the method. The result of the experiment shows that the selection of threshold significantly influences matching accuracy. When the threshold is selected properly, the proposed algorithm can match line entities effectively, thus establishing the association relationship between spatial entities of multi-source vector data. Moreover, the precision and accuracy are notable.

articleTitle: Research on automatic sorting system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the gradual popularization of automation technology in agricultural production, the level of intelligence and automation of agricultural production is getting higher and higher. The traditional sorting system adopts the manual sorting method, which is inefficient, time-consuming, low accuracy and consumes a lot of human and material resources. In order to solve the above problems, the machine vision technology and PLC technology are integrated, the automatic sorting device is designed, the overall design scheme of the automatic sorting device is completed, and the hardware design and control process design of the sorting device control system are carried out. Finally, the sorting accuracy and efficiency of the sorting device are tested and verified. The results show that the automatic sorting device based on the integration of machine vision and PLC has simple structure, fast sorting speed, high control accuracy, safety and stability, and has great promotion value.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of single tag attachment orientation on contact sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the growing application of passive ultra-high frequency (UHF) radio frequency identification (RFID) technology in the area of the Internet of Things in recent years, the use of RFID to monitor liquid level has progressively become an important research challenge in the domains of healthcare and industrial plants. In this paper, a single RFID tag is attached to a liquid bottle in both horizontal and vertical orientations to investigate the change of RSSI values for the two attachment techniques at various transmitting powers, according to the backscattering properties of RFID. The experimental results indicate that the RSSI values of the two attachment methods have a more stable variation trend at high transmitting power, and the fluctuation curve of RSSI under the vertical attachment method has more significant changes and a stable shift pattern, which has a significant meaning for the applications of tag-based liquid level detection.

articleTitle: Coal gangue detection method based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Accurate identification of coal and gangue is helpful to improve the quality of raw coal. Based on the YOLOv5 algorithm, a new model yoloV5-SEDE with high precision and fast convergence is proposed. First, Mosaic data enhancement method is used to randomly crop and scale images to form new images to expand the data set. Nine anchor frames are generated by k-means clustering. After that, SENet attention module was added to enhance the identification ability of coal gangue targets, suppress invalid features and improve the utilization rate of feature information. SPPF structure is used instead of SPP structure to enrich the expression ability of feature mapping. In the feature fusion stage, the original feature pyramid fusion method is replaced by BiFPN weighted feature pyramid fusion method to make the semantic features obtained from the network have stronger robustness. Compared with the original target recognition algorithm, the average accuracy of this algorithm is improved by 1.59% (MAP_0.5) and 2.57% (MAP_0.5:0.95) respectively.

articleTitle: Super-resolution Reconstruction of Airborne Remote Sensing Images based on Multi-scale Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To extract more detailed features of airborne remote sensing images to obtain more information, super-resolution reconstruction is performed on them. However, the existing super-resolution reconstruction algorithms of airborne remote sensing images have poor feature extraction capabilities, and smooth image edges, and are difficult to restore high-frequency information effectively. In this paper, the residual features of different residual modules are densely connected to form a dense group (DG), which combines different residual features to reduce the redundancy of features and ensure the effective transmission of high-frequency residual features. Further, the residual features of DG are densely connected to realize the reuse of information, and combined with multi-scale fusion, a two-branch lightweight multi-scale fusion super-resolution reconstruction network is proposed. The experimental results show that the algorithm has good performance and is lightweight, and can obtain a better reconstruction effect.

articleTitle: Research on task offload for edge computing in high-speed railway vehicle ground communication network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As the key technology of Intelligent Railway 5g network, edge computing sinks the data caching capacity, traffic forwarding capacity and application service capacity to the edge of the network, effectively meeting the requirements of Intelligent Railway for low delay, large bandwidth and massive connection, so as to support the application of intelligent rail transit. However, due to the complexity and high dynamics of the high-speed railway operation environment, its train ground communication network has some problems, such as poor transmission stability, low throughput, limited wireless resources between trains and ground, and low utilization efficiency. In order to further optimize scheduling resources and improve system performance, this paper studies the task unloading problem of mobile edge computing (MEC) in the high-speed railway train ground communication network, A task unloading scheme is designed, and the effectiveness of the scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Implementation and Optimization of Distributed Stream Processing System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As one of the most popular big data processing engines, Apache Storm is used in many fields. However, the performance of the traditional Storm framework can no longer meet current needs due to explosive growth of data in Internet of Things. In this article, FPGA is integrated as the computing node into the Strom framework, and two optimization methods are proposed for the framework to improve system performance. We use matrix multiplication to evaluate the optimized system. When the matrix size is 256×256, the FPGA-based Storm system has a maximum reduction of 37.10% in the average processing delay of tuples compared to the native Storm system. When the computing resources of the FPGA are large enough, the matrix size of the optimal optimization rate will also increase by increasing the parameter setting of the expansion degree.

articleTitle: Intelligent detection of mask wearing based on cloud-edge collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuation of the Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) epidemic, the epidemic prevention experience of various countries has confirmed that wearing a mask is an effective way to reduce the spread of the virus. With the repeated epidemics, China's epidemic prevention has entered a normalized management, and people's awareness of protection has declined to a certain extent compared with the initial stage of the epidemic, and there have been cases of incorrectly wearing a mask or even not wearing a mask. Some regulatory and technological means are necessary to stabilize the results of epidemic prevention and remind people to wear a mask in public. This paper proposes an intelligent detection scheme for mask wearing based on cloud-edge collaboration, which uses the You Look Only Once (YOLO) target detection algorithm to detect the situation of people wearing a mask in public places. This solution introduces the cloud-edge collaboration mechanism into the Internet of Things (IoT). Under this mechanism, the cloud center uses a larger image dataset to train the mask detection model, and the trained model will be released to the intelligent detection camera through IoT. In this way, the camera at the edge site can accurately detect the case of mask wearing. This mechanism can make full use of cloud center resources, improve the detection speed of edge site cameras, and promptly correct the behavior of incorrectly wearing a mask. It only sends the detection results to the cloud center instead of the original images, which can effectively reduce the transmission bandwidth of IoT. The experimental results show that the intelligent detection scheme of mask wearing with cloud-edge collaboration mechanism can achieve better detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A GAN-based adaptive embedded digital label information hiding scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, digital label technology has entered into people’s life, and is widely used in data tracking, traceability and monitoring. However, with the development of big data, the apperance of more potential attack methods, the existing digital label technology is hard to meet the security requirements. Therefore, this paper proposes a GAN-based adaptive embedded digital label information hiding scheme. This scheme: 1) introduces adversarial samples and using adversarial networks to strengthen the carrier information, improving the anti-hidden analysis ability of secret information; 2) introduces an attention mechanism into the generator network, and improves the extraction accuracy of digital labels. A better embedding probability calculation is realized, and the quality of the dense carrier is guaranteed; 3) designs the analyzer network, improving the anti-hidden analysis ability of digital labels.

articleTitle: Research on quality prediction of iron ore green pellets based on optimized neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: High-quality green pellets are a prerequisite for obtaining high-yield and high-quality pellets, and are the key factors and desired targets to be controlled in the pellet production process. Predicting the green pellets quality (green pellet drop strength, compressive strength and burst temperature) can guide the field staff to set the process parameters in a more timely manner, which will also be more conducive to producing high-quality finished pellets. In this paper, an improved whale optimization algorithm is proposed to optimize and adjust the smooth factor of the GRNN neural network and establishes a GRNN prediction model, further improving the global optimization ability and convergence speed of the GRNN neural network. The quality prediction model is finally simulated and analyzed with the data collected in the laboratory. Through the analysis of the error results, it may observe that the improved model has higher prediction accuracy and faster convergence speed, and has a more powerful function than the traditional neural network model.

articleTitle: AUV Path Planning and Image Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) has been widely used in marine resources development and underwater engineering operations. Vision is one of the most important environmental testing technologies at present, and Convolutional Neural Networks are widely used in target testing. Based on LENET-5, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for underwater training set was proposed, and image recognition was implemented through Raspberry PI. AUV controls the camera and underwater lighting through Raspberry Pi, and builds a model based on the TensorFlow framework. The tested dataset showed that the accuracy of the 7-layer Convolutional Neural Network is only 80%. So,in this paper, the Convolutional Neural Network was improved to finally design a 13-layer neural network, including 1 input layer, 4 convolutional layers, 4 pooling layers, 3 fully connected layers, and 1 output layer. After 100 iteration training experiments, the accuracy of underwater target recognition reached 99.18%, and the independent underwater robot underwater target recognition was achieved.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of substances in passive RFID contactless sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As passive RFID sensing technology develops, the effect of different substances in the application environments on the tag’s backscattered signal has become a promising area of research, particularly the difference between the effect of liquid and non-liquid environments in non-contact sensing mode. As RSSI is the most accessible signal measurement metric, this paper uses the degree of RSSI fluctuation to describe the environmental influence on the tag signal. To quantitatively analyse the difference in environmental impact, this paper compares the change in the RSSI value of the tag signal before and after the addition of pure water into the glass container, and analyzes the impact of the substance inside the container on the tag signal at different location points by changing the distance between the glass container and the RFID tag. By analyzing the measured data, it can be verified that both the water-filled bottle and the empty bottle have a cyclical impact on the RSSI, and the cyclical pattern is basically the same, however, the RSSI fluctuation value under the water-filled container is significantly higher than that under the empty bottle due to the effect of pure water on the RF signal, indicating that the fluctuation value of the tag signal can be used as a feature to reflect the composition of the substance. In subsequent passive RFID contactless sensing applications, the RSSI fluctuation may therefore be used as a key characteristic.

articleTitle: Gradient Based Formation Algorithm with FOV Constraint
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: A gradient based formation controller is proposed in this work to settle the problem of leader-follower formation building with FOV constraint, and the barrier-like cost function is designed to encounter the requirements of the predefined FOV area. The simulation result and Lyapunov stability analyze is illustrated to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Improving Classroom Object Detection with Bootstrapped Semi-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, smarter classroom education becomes more and more popular. In classroom intelligence, object detection plays a vital role . However, due to the lack of large classroom dataset, it is hard to obtain excellent classroom domain-specific detection model. To address the problem, we propose a novel bootstrap semi-supervised algorithm. The algorithm uses general labeled detection datasets, such as VOC, and large unlabeled classroom datasets for training, and improves model performance through bootstrap learning. We conduct experiments on the common YOLOv5-S model. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our work, and facilitate the study of classroom teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Variational Autoencoders and its Interpretability Based on Gaussian Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As one of the important generative models, Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) can complete the feature characterization and generation of data. However, their reconstruction effect on high-resolution images is often not high. The poor image quality is partly due to the limited space for hiding variables. In order to solve this problem, based on the optimization model GCMVAE based on VAEs, this paper improves the generation ability of the model and studies its interpretability. In this study, the interpretability research focuses on the interpretation of some models without semantic information in different stages of the model. Finally, through the analysis of the results, we can get the characteristics of data, the distribution characteristics of implicit variables and the different learning stages experienced in the process of data generation.

articleTitle: Optimization design of unpowered aircraft model based on EPP material
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of China's aviation industry, self-developed large aircraft have made successful test flights. Model airplanes are becoming a popular toy all over the country. In this paper, a common small unpowered aircraft model in the current market as the research object, with EPP - foamed polypropylene as the base material, through the existing unpowered aircraft model in the fuselage and wing structure of the optimization design, in order to make the aircraft model in flight lag time and jetting trajectory can be improved and optimized in two aspects.

articleTitle: A Real-time Path Planner based on Improved Tentacle Algorithm for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, a real-time local path planner for obstacle avoidance of autonomous vehicles is proposed. Based on the tentacle algorithm, a novel tentacle curve that can ensure the continuity of the derivative of the path curvature is used to generate an alternate path set. After collision detection, we use the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to calculate the weights to choose the best path. Finally, to verify the efficiency of the proposed planner, an obstacle avoidance case is designed in the simulation. The simulation results show that the proposed planner can obviously avoid the obstacle well and has better smoothness than the tentacle approach that uses the clothoid curve. The total time of local planning within a single period is less than 20 ms, which still has great real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Electric Power Administrative Exchange Network Based on IMS Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid construction of the energy Internet, the traditional program-controlled switching network cannot meet the needs of new power communications services such as video calls and multimedia enhancements. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a power administrative switching network solution based on IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) technology and implements it in the Anhui power grid system. IMS adopts an architecture that separates services, control, and bearer, which is more advanced than soft switching and circuit switching technologies, and is suitable for the deployment and development of multimedia services. IMS is to build an integrated platform that has nothing to do with access and supports a wide range of multimedia services, empowers IP networks, serves customer needs, and provides a strong guarantee for the construction of energy Internet.

articleTitle: Image-Attention based User Entity Recognition of Device
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this study, we investigate a method for identifying the attribution of domain user based on web page information. In the process of using domains, users or network administrators usually use the method of querying the domain registry or open portal website when detecting the real organization of the domain. However, because many organizations rely on the services provided by cloud service providers and domain service providers, The user obtained by the traditional query method is often the registration user of the domain, not the user of the domain. Named entity recognition, as an important branch of natural language processing, usually only processes and recognizes information through text. However, the information provided by the webpage contains both text and images, and many images also contain the name of the user to which the domain belongs. In the research of this paper, using the text information in the website and the user information in the image, a multi-modal fusion method is proposed to identify the user to which the domain belongs.

articleTitle: A Nearest Neighbor Projection Method Based on Z Curve
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: When the projection direction is uncertain, the projected surface and the amount of mesh data are constantly increasing, which reduces the efficiency of projection calculation. In order to solve this problem, this paper uses the Z curve to reduce the dimension and the properties of data clustering, and based on the construction principle of Z-order curve, the discrete point data is divided and mapped to the Z curve, and the nearest distance point is quickly searched, and this point is used as the initial iteration point, and then use Newton iteration to search the surface area where the closest point is located to obtain the exact projected point. The comparison of numerical experiments shows that the projection query algorithm based on Z-order curve has better efficiency and effect.

articleTitle: Detection of Shoreline Erosion using Satellite Image and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As we get more advanced in technology, we produce more pollution to the world and hurt the environment overall. The climate change is one of the examples of the environment being harmed by human actions. The negative sides of climate change are the increase of temperature for all four seasons and the rising of sea level. The rising of sea level causes the losing of land mass. It poses a necessity in collecting the data of the shoreline and see how it influences the position of the shoreline. In order to prevent the further deterioration of erosion, it will be necessary to use the prior data and make further prediction based on the data collected from the past.

articleTitle: Ship trajectory prediction model based on PSO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of ship trajectory, propose a PSO-LSTM model used Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize the number of hidden units and learning rate of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network. Then use the PSO-LSTM model to predict ship trajectories. The PSO algorithm can effectively find the global optimal solution, and has a good effect on the problem of difficult selection of LSTM hyperparameters. The prediction process is divided into three steps: (1) data processing (2) PSO algorithm optimization (3) PSO-LSTM model prediction. The PSO-LSTM model is verified by AIS data, and the Back Propagation (BP) model is added to compare with the traditional LSTM model. The results show that the proposed prediction model has better accuracy and stability.

Author Keywords: long and short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: A Reinforcement Learning based RRT Algorithm with Value Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Path planning algorithm is always a heated area of robotics. Researchers propose various of algorithms to meet different requirements. Yet a remaining issue for path planning in unknown environment is that little information is available. For these occasions, researchers proposed sampling-based path planning algorithm such as Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees. This kind of method relies greatly on the sampled points. Noticing that reinforcement learning methods learn about the environment during the interaction process, it is manageable to combine these two methods to improve algorithm’s behavior. In this manuscript, a reinforcement learning based RRT algorithm is proposed to search path in environment with little previous information. The proposed method uses value estimation from reinforcement learning to encourage exploration and makes the agent sample points from less visited area. According to simulation results, the proposed algorithm has higher utilization of the tree nodes and explores more area comparing with RRT algorithm.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting the State of Sensors and Meters Based on Improved Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Sensors and meters are used in a wide range of applications, the effects of anomalies or failures are increasing. Therefore, accurate and efficient state prediction methods are required. In this paper, the main problem of state prediction— imbalanced classification is studied. The traditional GAN and CatGAN are analyzed, and an improved model CatGAN-SP is proposed for the problem of state prediction. The relevant objective functions are deduced, and the specific expressions of the objective functions are given. The experimental verification was carried out using measured data of ultrasonic flowmeter. The effectiveness of the model in sensors state prediction problem is proved by comparison with related algorithms. In particular, the model further solves the class imbalance problem and improves the accuracy of sensors state prediction effectively.

articleTitle: Prediction of Defect Occurrence of Substation Equipment Based on Time Series and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The defect management of substation equipment is an important part of substation operation management. A large number of equipment damage requires more equipment maintenance force. By scientifically predicting the occurrence rate of equipment defects, the normal operation of the equipment can be guaranteed in time and the difficulty of equipment maintenance can be reduced. Aiming at the problem that the current substation equipment defect prediction model is relatively simple and the influence of comprehensive historical data on defect prediction, this paper proposes a substation equipment defect prediction method based on time-series and neural network. Firstly, through analysis and processing, five important parameters such as the manufacturer, equipment model, voltage level, the number of months of operation, and the number of months, the defect prediction of equipment were taken as the characteristic variable of defect prediction. Then, the time series features were constructed for the specified parameters, and the specified parameters were encoded in the form of one-hot encoding to construct the dataset. Finally, the probability of occurrence of defects in the time window was predicted through the multi-layer perceptron network model. Compared with the experimental link, the prediction accuracy of the algorithm can reach 89.7%, and the practical application in the defect detection of substation equipment can provide certain support for the maintenance of substation equipment.

articleTitle: EEG Emotion Recognition Based on a Novel 4D Feature Fusion and 3D Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Emotion recognition based on electroencephalogram (EEG) signals has become an important research field in recent years due to its application in human-computer interaction. Feature fusion is the solution strategy in many pattern recognition works. However, there are few related works on EEG feature fusion. This research field has much room for development. This paper proposes a 4-dimensional representation method of multiple features across channels and frequency bands and 3D convolution neural network (3D-CNN) for EEG emotion recognition.
