Specifically, we perform two-dimensional electrode position relationship mapping on the extracted one-dimensional sequences of different features. The obtained 2D features are fused to the three-dimensional array to achieve complementarity between features. The 3D features of different frequency bands are then formed into the four-dimensional feature to capture cross-band information. We adopt the subject-independent approach to conduct experiments on the SEED dataset. Compared with the state-of-the-art emotion classification method, the classification performance is improved with an average accuracy of 98.64%. The 4-dimensional representation method combining different features proposed in this paper is proved to be significant in feature extraction and fusion.

articleTitle: Analysis of association rules between serum mass spectrometry data and physical examination data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Physical examination data and serum mass spectrometry data are obtained through the blood, serum mass spectrometry data are so inextricably linked between the patient's serum mass spectrometry data and the physical examination data, using the Association Analysis Algorithm in data mining to correlate the attributes of serum mass spectrometry data and physical examination data, the analysis results obtained have an important reference value for the process of decision designation and are of great significance for the development of medical blood testing .

articleTitle: Individual Police Equipment Management System Based on The Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology has been widely applied in intelligent management in fields of traffic control, military logistics and fire services. Under the backdrop of police big data strategy, intelligent police equipment systems have been built and tested as pilot projects in some developed areas in China, but there is still much room for improvement in terms of structure, function and practicality. To solve the existing problems, this essay aims to put forward an individual police equipment management system in virtue of domain-based Reference Model of the Internet of Things. This system efficiently realizes the whole-process and whole-life management of individual police equipment, reduces the cost and exchanges data and intelligence with peer systems.

articleTitle: Learning Search Region Update for Roubst Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Visual object tracking is a challenging task in computer vision. In tracking a target, trackers will encounter a series of factors such as camera motion (CM), background clutter (BC), and illumination variation (IV). It is easy for the existing trackers to deal with the above problems, however, handling the long-time full occlusion (FOC) is difficult. In this article, we collect a vehicle tracking dataset named VIP-FOC with the attribute of full occlusion. We propose a long-term tracking method based on the time series trajectory prediction model. When the tracking target disappears, the tracker uses the trajectory to infer the position of the tracking target. If the tracking target reappears in the view again, the tracker uses the appearance and trajectory to re-lock the tracking target. Experiments on OTB2015, VOT2019, and VIP-FOC databases show that our tracker can solve the long-term occlusion problem successfully and holds good performance on public datasets.

articleTitle: Analysis of Passenger Landside Travel Characteristics of Airport Hub Based on Mobile Signaling Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Mobile signaling data provides a new data source for studying the travel time-space characteristics of air passengers. Based on the mobile phone signaling data, this paper analyzes the characteristics of Fuzhou Changle International Airport’s inbound and outbound passengers, such as travel time, residence location, travel trajectory and so on. The results show that Fuzhou is the main hinterland of Fuzhou airport, accounting for about 85% of trips in this city, and more than 97% of trips in Fuzhou Putian Ningde metropolitan area. The single land side transportation mode is an important reason that restricts the passenger transport development of Fuzhou airport at present. More than 80% of passengers arrive at the airport for more than 30 minutes. In the future, Fuzhou airport should accelerate the construction of a composite passenger transport hub of "airport + high-speed rail / intercity rail", further improve the airport collection and distribution system, effectively expand the airport hinterland, and continuously improve the portal function of the airport hub.

articleTitle: Real-Time Infrared Target Tracking on Embedded Platform Based on Improved Staple Tracker
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Infrared target tracking aims to continuously obtain the position and size of specific infrared target in image sequences or videos. Existing tracking methods based on correlation filter are limited to the spatial texture of infrared target, which cannot tackle completely insufficiency of feature information in tracking process. To solve the problem, we propose a real-time infrared target tracking method in this paper, which combines the probability map of edge features and Staple tracking algorithm. Specifically, the proposed method enhances the edge details between infrared target and background and learns the deformation of infrared target. To cope with occlusion during infrared target tracking, we incorporate a template update module with average peak correlation energy to detect the occlusion of infrared target and selectively update the tracking template model. The experimental results show that the improved method achieves satisfactory improvement compared with the original Staple algorithm in the tracking precision and success rate. Furthermore, we also achieve real-time running on the embedded platform.

articleTitle: Microsoft Malware Prediction Using LightGBM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The development of Windows malware detection technology and the evolution of malware are complementary and inseparable. Traditional malware detection methods mainly include signature-based detection, heuristic-based detection, and dynamic behaviour-based detection. Thanks to the development of computer hardware and artificial intelligence technology, machine learning and deep learning have achieved many remarkable research results in many fields, and researchers in network security are also paying more and more attention to machine learning. In our paper, we do feature engineering and use LightGBM as our model to process data. To evaluate our method’s performance, we use Auc-Roc as the metric. The higher the Auc-Roc Score and accuracy are, the better performance the model will gain. LightGBM model owns the highest Auc-Roc score 0.684, which is 0.046 and 0.007 higher than Catboost and Xgboost respectively.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network Optimization Strategy based on Roofline Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: It is obvious that the inference time of the deep neural network (DNN) may be various when DNN is deployed on different types of devices. Relying on the device features, DNN may be further optimized significantly. This paper proposes a DNN’s optimization strategy based on device’s Roofline Model, which can be carried out as follows: Firstly, the device’s Roofline Model is modeled, and computing characteristics of the device are evaluated correspondingly. Secondly, some convolutional layers are picked out as optimal objects, from the original DNN specified by users, according to their floating point operations and memory access cost. Thirdly, based on the Roofline Model, the working regions of the layers with different convolution structure are classified as computing bound region or memory bound region. Fourthly, the inference time is evaluated according to their working regions, and all time-optimal convolution structures of the layers are reached. Finally, these obtained convolution structures are used to reconstruct the original DNN. As an example, YOLO v3 is optimized for Jetson NANO by applying above strategy, namely, YOLO v3-R. The results show that the inference time of YOLO v3-R is 26% lower than YOLO v3, while keeping mAP almost constant.

articleTitle: Research on the semantic segmentation algorithm for automatic driving with improved HRNet
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In automatic driving, semantic segmentation plays a very important role. A proposed image semantic segmentation algorithm based on HRNet joint cross-attention mechanism addresses the problems of low resolution of feature maps extracted by current mainstream image semantic segmentation algorithms, excessive loss of effective semantic information during upsampling, and easy loss of pixel points and relevance of target object regions. A denoising module is incorporated into the segmentation model during the training process to improve training speed and robustness. In comparison with the original segmentation model, this method produces an mIoU of 83.2% in the widely used Cityscapes dataset.

articleTitle: A moving target detection method based on Dempster-Shafer Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Moving target recognition has always been an important task in the field of computer vision. In this paper, we proposed a three-stage moving object detection method to solve the problem of difficulty in detecting target objects of the presence of complex backgrounds and occludes. This method first uses OTSU to perform threshold segmentation on the four color channels, then uses the Dempster Shafer theory to introduce historical information and fuse the segmentation results, and finally uses the dilation like method to compensate for the loss of information on the fusion process, identifying with the target object. This algorithm has been applied to the actual UAV formation flight task and has been proven to be stable and real-time.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Dot Matrix Display Based on Proteus
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Taking AT89c51 microcontroller as the control core, a 16*16 dot matrix display is designed by using 74HC595, 74LS138 chips and 8*8 dot matrix. Based on the Proteus simulation software, the circuit design of the dot matrix display is completed. The main program and the interrupt service routine are written and debugged through the Keil software combined with the C language, and the static display of a single character and the conversion of the dynamic display of multiple characters are realized. The simulation results show that the circuit design is reasonable, the programming is correct, and the dot matrix display can achieve the expected effect.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Approach for COVID-19 Fact Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The rapid development of social media platforms has resulted in a fast-paced spread of misinformation, which is especially common in the COVID-19 pandemic. In the global pandemic, the amount of COVID-19 related fake news generated online becomes enormous, which negatively results in public tension. Moreover, rumours are spread across platforms from different countries in such a global pandemic. Thus, automated fact-checking, which refers to automatically verifying the correctness of a claim, is of great importance. In this paper, we propose and examine ensemble learning approaches that exploit the power of multiple large-scale pre-trained language models. We conduct extensive experiments on traditional approaches, learning-based approaches, and our proposed ensemble methods. We successfully advance state-of-the-art performance by a significant margin. Further, we show that our ensemble method is especially suited to tasks with scarce training data, making it more suitable for many real-world applications.

articleTitle: Predict the Complexity of Literary Passages Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Graded reading is becoming increasingly important in everyday life. For example, recommending books suitable for the reading difficulty of the current age to children can bring great convenience to parents. At the same time, it can also increase children’s interest in reading and prevent them from being stressed because of the difficulty of reading. However, using humans to judge the reading difficulty of texts and then grading them requires more manpower and material resources. We need to use deep learning methods to automatically judge the reading difficulty of text. Our paper proposes a Roberta-based model to rate the difficulty of a given text. First, the data set is preprocessed, and then use the training data set and the validation data set to train and optimize the model. In addition, our model is compared with LSTM and RNN. Experiments show that the model proposed in this paper has better performance on the task of text reading difficulty classification.

articleTitle: An integrated road-slippery condition recognition system based on vehicle-Infrastructure cooperative
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The slippery road condition perception system is required to assist intelligent vehicles. However, the existing road condition perception system mostly works independently, which brings a warning-delay. As a solution, this paper designs an integrated road-slippery condition recognition system based on vehicle-Infrastructure cooperative. Firstly, a pretrained road-slippery condition recognition model with modified threshold is built based on Inception-v3. Secondly, the vehicle-road cooperative network is set up and the real-time vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system based on DSRC is realized. Finally, to achieve visualization, an APP on Mobile phone is constructed to display the road recognition results. The whole system shows high real-time performance, low omission rate and good recognition accuracy under four typical road conditions' test.

articleTitle: Digital Inclusion: A Study on Optimizing Emotional UI Design Based on the Characteristics of Older People
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the simultaneous arrival of digitalization and aging, older people are more likely to use online applications. Based on the characteristics of elderly users, this study explores the direction of UI emotional design. First, the authors summarize and analyze the interface elements and emotional design. Secondly, based on the physiological and psychological characteristics of the elderly, they investigate the characteristics of elderly users, analyze their influence on UI design, and propose design optimization strategies. For instance, they suggest building a "familiar" interface language for the elderly, creating a good interface visual effect, providing practical and clear operation feedback, and more positive emotional feedback. The research results can provide methodological guidance for the UI design of mobile applications.

articleTitle: Research on microwave signal recognition of motor imagination brain activity based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, the original data of microwave signals of motor imagination brain activity is obtained through experiments. The entropy eigenvalues of the original data are extracted, and then PCA is used to reduce the dimension and optimize the characteristic data. Finally, SVM classifier and SVM-BETTER classification model are used to recognize brain activity signals. The experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the SVM-BETTER classifier is 0.8737, which is higher than most current research methods, It can accurately recognize the brain activity information of motor imagination.

articleTitle: Parameter Update Framework based on Unitized Stochastic Gradient Descent Algorithm in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Although the aim of federated learning is to solve the problem of data island and privacy preserving, it is found that federated learning itself also has the risk of privacy leakage due to the corrupted participants. In this paper, a collaborative federated learning framework is proposed to address the problem of privacy leakage during model training caused by honest-but-curious servers. The framework is based on the unitized stochastic gradient descent algorithm to selectively update the parameters to protect the gradient. The experimental results indicate that the proposed framework makes the server failed to infer explicit information from the model, which further improves the degree of privacy protection and ensures the accuracy of model training.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion based on CNN and Saliency Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel image fusion framework is proposed for fusing the infrared and visible images based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and saliency detection. The proposed framework overcomes the bottleneck of previous pixelbased CNN methods in that it preserves the intensity and texture homogeneity within the saliency regions. First, an initial fused image was obtained using a two-channel CNN. Then a saliency map is derived based on the difference in structural similarity between the infrared and visible source images with the initial fused image. Finally, a weighted fusion rule is applied to generate the fused image. The proposed method was validated on a combined dataset of CIFAR-10 dataset and the TNO image fusion dataset. The results show that the fused images with CNN and saliency detection present good infrared target features as well as clear visible background, and effectively preserve the visual details and infrared features of the target regions. Our method showed improved performance over the state-of-the-art image fusion methods in qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

articleTitle: Establishing a Knowledge Base of an Expert System for Criminal Investigation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the information era, knowledge is becoming increasingly significant for all industries, especially criminal investigation that deeply relies on intelligence and strategies. Therefore, there is an urgent need for effective management and utilization of criminal investigation knowledge. As an important branch of knowledge engineering, the expert system can simulate the thinking pattern of an expert, proposing strategies and solutions based on the knowledge stored in the knowledge base. A crucial step in building the expert system is to construct the knowledge base, which determines the function and capability of the expert system. This paper establishes a practical knowledge base for criminal investigation, combining the technologies of cloud computing with traditional method of manual entry to acquire and process knowledge. The knowledge base covers data information and expert knowledge with detailed classification of rules and cases, providing answers through comparison and reasoning. The knowledge becomes more accurate and reliable after repeated inspection and verification by human experts.

articleTitle: Multi-label Detection Method of Facial Protection Based on Deep YOLO Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Wearing face protectors is an important means of personal safety protection, and the corresponding detection technology plays a critical role in the face of major public security incidents. At present, the detection methods of face protectors do not fully utilize the features of protectors on the face and have the problem that it is impossible to detect the wearing situation of two or more types of face protectors at the same time. This paper integrates the features of the face region and the region of protectors, takes the fused features of the two regions as the basis of object classification, and converts the multi-label classification into multi-channel binary classification problems, which effectively reduces the difficulty of detection. On this basis, a face protectors multi-label detection method based on deep YOLO network is proposed. The experimental results show that this method can detect the multi-label information of the wearing situation of the face protectors, and effectively improve the accuracy of the detection of face protectors.

articleTitle: Ambulation Prediction by Fusing Raw IMU Data and Novel sEMG Time-frequency Features
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper proposed and implemented an experiment to compare the accuracy rate, sensitivity, precision, F1-score, and stability of different feature-level fusion prediction models predicting five lower limb activities of daily living (ADL) in data from 18 healthy human subjects. The results of this work show that a high-level feature fusion CNN model with the time-frequency features of sEMG and raw IMU data has produced significantly stable and more accurately predicted results than SVM models with other time-domain and frequency-domain features, especially the multivariate synchrosqueezing transform (MSST) features, which have maximum accuracy and stability increments of 1.23% and 3.08%, respectively, without more manual feature encoding. It is concluded that the results demonstrate the validity and feasibility of the MSST for extracting muscle activity features and integrating features in a more advanced and novel way to ensure the prediction of daily lower limb ambulation activities.

articleTitle: A short-wave reconnaissance equipment scheduling technology based on Hopfield network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Short-wave band signal density, complex electromagnetic environment and relatively limited detection equipment often lead to low detection efficiency. Aiming at this situation, a scheduling method of short-wave detection equipment based on Hopfield neural network is proposed to carry out cooperative detection of short-wave signals. In this paper, the definition of effective detection probability is given, the constraints of effective detection are sorted out, and the mathematical model of detection equipment scheduling is designed, which is realized by Hopfield neural network. This method uses the global optimization technology to schedule multiple detection sensors, so that different detection sensors can cooperate reasonably and maximize the overall benefit of detection system. Simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Worksite’s Video Image Safety Helmet Detection Method Based on Cloud-edge Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of worksites staff, solve the problem that worksite monitoring video transmission occupies many network resources, has high time delay and cannot detect staff not wearing safety helmets in real time, a method for detecting safety helmets in video images of worksites based on cloud-edge cooperation is designed. The YOLOv3 algorithm is used for training the helmet detection model. Using the feature that the cloud-edge cooperation model can reduce processing latency, tasks such as model training and optimization, which are computationally intensive and have low real-time requirements, are handled by the cloud, and tasks such as target detection, which are relatively less computationally intensive and have high real-time requirements, are handled by the edge. Deploy the helmet detection model on the edge node to process the surveillance video images locally, and alarm in time when the behavior of not wearing a helmet is detected; the cloud server receives the surveillance video data and the processing results of the edge, and sends the information to the edge. The information and data are analyzed and calculated, the model is updated and optimized, and then the optimized model is pushed to the edge nodes, so as to realize the data interaction and automatic model optimization of the whole system. The experimental results show that this system can significantly reduce the surveillance video processing delay while maintaining a high recognition rate.

articleTitle: Oil and Fas Field Heating Device Based on Modularization Analysis of Heat Energy Exchange Resistance Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Taking the thermal energy exchange simulation analysis system of oil and gas field heating devices as the research object, it is first classified according to different standards, and the heat exchange system is divided into multiple modules such as heat energy source heat exchange unit heating unit. Starting from the fuel combustion, the design and analysis parameters of each module unit of the system are analyzed, and the correlation between the operating parameters and the device structure, system efficiency and so on is established. Take resistance analysis as an example, analyze and study the possible characteristics of resistance, and finally build a system analysis method and simulation analysis process based on modular analysis.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multiple Cameras Monitoring and Streaming Based on Auto-layout and Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper provides a novel implementation method to develop a simultaneous monitor and visual streaming toolkit for multiple cameras. The implementation of the research of this paper uses the four main libraries to implement: FFmpeg, OpenCV, PIL and Tkinter. This streaming toolkit can implement the visible monitoring and streaming for multiple cameras simultaneously. Moverover, this streaming toolkit can achieve the function of arranging the visual display layout windows of multiple cameras. The inside interpreter of this streaming toolkit can intelligently analyze the input text of the streaming URL string and find out the correct protocol for camera streaming. Furthermore, enough experiments have been taken to test the monitoring and streaming performance and efficiency of this toolkit. This monitoring and streaming toolkit is able to gain the multimedia equipment information of the computer and make the corresponding configuration.

articleTitle: A New Method to Measure the Distance of Two Evidence Bodies
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Evidence theory is an effective uncertainty reasoning method. But when evidence system is highly conflict, D-S combination rule will generate a counter-intuitive result. There are many ways to resolve this situation. One category of modified methods is to weight the evidence bodies of evidence system again. These methods use Jousselme distance, Pignistic probability transformation, information entropy, interval distance and so on. By analyzing these methods, we give a new method to measure the distance of two evidence bodies and then give the weight of evidences bodies by using the new distance. Final example shows the validity of our proposed distance.

articleTitle: Machine Reading Comprehension for Continuous Questions via Multi-Task Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Machine Reading Comprehension for Continuous questions (Cq-MRC) is an important branch of MRC, which requires to answer a series of follow-up questions with the given passages. Questions in Cq-MRC are usually incomplete and may co-reference to previous ones. To tackle these challenges more efficiently, we propose a deep neural model via multi-task learning, in which key-entity prediction is regarded as the auxiliary task to help the model focus on significant entities which may be ignored and in turn improve the performance of the main task, answer prediction. Two subtasks share the same representation vector and feature encoder and are trained jointly, so that they can learn from each other. In addition, we design a static weight distribution approach to assign the optimal weight to subtasks. Experiments conducted on a massive MRC dataset, Les MMRC 2.0, demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Crypto Profit Forecasting using hybrid Machine Learning method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The resulting digital cryptocurrency has drawn investors' attention with its new architectural design and soaring prices. Over ＄40 billion worth of cryptocurrencies are traded every day. Quantitative investment is a new type of investment method. It belongs to the cross-integration of finance, mathematics, statistics and computer science. In our paper, we hybrid Catboost and XGboost for Crypto Forecasting. The dataset is provided by Kaggle platform. To compare our model’s performance, we do compared experiments. From the compared experiments, our model owns the highest RMSPE: 0.0359. In contrast, the other methods like Gradient Boosting, XGBoost and CatBoost’s accuracy are 0.0312, 0.0349 and 0.0355 respectively.

articleTitle: Deep application of meter file verification APP based on the flexible platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Users in the distribution station area often increase or decrease the user meter files in the distribution station area due to the relocation of their residences. Due to the untimely update of the file information of the cloud master station, the files of the cloud master station are not updated in time. The terminal files in the distribution and transformation station area are inconsistent, which leads to confusion in the user relationship data of the acquisition system, and brings a lot of work to the later data management. Based on the flexible platform, the meter file verification APP is developed to complete the automatic verification of cloud-use files and terminal files.

Author Keywords: verification of use and acquisition files

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis of Power User Loads Based on KPCA and K-means++
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In view of China's fiercely competitive power market, more power companies want to study the power consumption habits of power users to provide more personalized services. This paper proposes a power user load clustering method based on KPCA and K-means++. After the user load data is dimensionally reduced by KPCA, K-means++ is used for clustering processing. The experiment uses the 2018 power user load data in a region in northeastern China to simulate. The results show that the proposed method has improved effectiveness and stability compared with other traditional clustering methods.

articleTitle: Non-contact voltage measurement based on electric field sensing integrated electro-optical sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Smart grids are aimed at improving the safety and reliability of grid operation. Smart sensors are the core element in building smart grids, and real-time sensing of voltage strength changes is an important reference indicator to fully grasp the operating status of the power system. Although the traditional contact voltage divider mode of voltage measurement has a high reliability, it has the disadvantages of narrow frequency band, weak immunity to electromagnetic interference and complex and inconvenient use. Based on the electromagnetic induction principle integrated electro-optical sensor as the core, this paper proposes a simplified decoupling method to achieve non-contact overvoltage measurement, effectively expanding the depth of overvoltage waveform information of the power grid, capturing different phase difference information of the distribution lines and obtaining the voltage of three-phase electricity. Applying the method to engineering practice, the no-load line closing transient voltage waveform was measured to be highly consistent with the actual.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection Model for Power Grids Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and machine vision technology, power grid inspection system based on vision is widely used. However, the power grid intelligent inspection system has the problem of unsatisfactory accuracy of small target detection. To address this problem, this paper proposes an intelligent detection model for power grids based on graph neural networks. Firstly, the VGG16 model is used to construct the trunk feature extraction network. Secondly, the graph relation network between target and background is constructed. Finally, the defect detection model based on graph neural network is constructed. The model proposed in this article is compared with the existing object recognition model in the simulation of the different datasets. The average recognition accuracy of the proposed model is 0.858, which is improved by9.71%.

articleTitle: Research on risk analysis method of urban and rural planning driven by data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the in-depth development of urban and rural economic construction in China, the urban planning system has gradually changed. In view of this problem, this paper has conducted in-depth research. First, it analyzes the urban and rural planning right from two aspects: the historical development of urban and rural planning right and the natural state of urban and rural planning right ownership. Then it studies the current allocation system of urban and rural planning right in China from four aspects: formulation, implementation, modification, supervision and inspection of urban and rural planning, and analyzes the current situation of practice in combination with the main problems exposed in the practice of urban and rural planning right in China. Secondly, according to the historical development context, this paper studies the development process of "multi compliance" in various places, focusing on the analysis of the main reasons for China’s "multi compliance" reform and the institutional causes of "multi compliance" problems. Thirdly, it analyzes the principles and influencing factors of the allocation of urban and rural planning rights under the background of "multi compliance", and makes an exploratory study for the specific allocation system design.

articleTitle: Design of an Integrated Automatic Test System for Streaming Media Delivery Network System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the testing process of streaming media delivery system, there are many problems, such as many test scenarios, complex operation process, long test time, large amount of test data and so on. This paper studies an integrated test system for streaming media delivery network system, in order to realize the accurate, fast and complete test of streaming media delivery system test scenario. Test system of streaming media delivery system include the test system with related tools, test platform and data server. The system can automatically call the test program and test tools according to the test content, which reduces the human error and greatly improves the test efficiency. In addition, a standardized and scientific test data management system has been established to ensure the integrity and objectivity of test data. Finally, the test capability and reliability of the system are verified by the automatically generated test report.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of license plate recognition system based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the complex high-speed traffic system, a set of license plate recognition system based on MATLAB is designed, which can automatically recognize the license plate information in the license plate image by using the digital image processing technology, so that the traffic system becomes digital. The specific process is to gray the collected license plate image first, then carry out edge detection, morphological processing and other processing, complete the two positioning of the license plate, and then carry out tilt correction, binarization, anti color, character segmentation after success, and finally use the template matching method to recognize the license plate characters. From the experimental results, the system can accurately locate the license plate and recognize the license plate number accurately and quickly, with good real-time and practicality.

articleTitle: Research on hardware assisted data cleaning algorithm for IoT Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things(IoT) applications and edge computing, the data cleaning algorithm based on anomaly detection adopted by IoT terminals requires stream data processing, low power consumption and real-time performance. Based on the study of the core clustering feature (CF) tree data structure and processing window type of BIRCH stream clustering algorithm, this paper proposes an IoT terminal data cleaning algorithm supported by the IoT terminal Storage and Computation Integrated (SCI) architecture for the first time, and makes a low-power application design and comparative analysis on the Phase Change Random Access Memory (PCRAM) CF tree data storage and access. Prototype based experiments and results analysis shows that the proposed algorithm can meet the intermittent working mode requirements of IoT terminals, reduce power consumption, meet the real-time and online data cleaning performance requirements, and can be extended to support more complex machine learning enhanced data cleaning algorithms.

articleTitle: Detect Deeply Only Once: Arbitrary-Oriented Object Detection in Remote Sensing Images Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To solve the problem that the existing arbitrary-oriented object detection cannot satisfy both high accuracy and high efficiency, a model called Detect Deeply Only Once is proposed. The model is based on the YOLOv5s_CSL network and is improved in three ways: (1) Three attention mechanisms are separately added to the appropriate positions of the model. All three attention mechanisms pay more attention to the features of interest and improve the detection accuracy. (2) The repeated weighted bi-directional feature pyramid network and path aggregation network are combined, which strengthens feature fusion ability among multiple layers. (3) Loss rank mining is employed after the final feature map, which filters some elements representing easy examples in the final feature map and forces the detectors to concentrate on hard examples during training. Meanwhile, the role of each module is verified on the HRSC2016 dataset, and the proposed method shows good superiority in terms of higher detection accuracy than the benchmark model and the state-of-the-art models on both HRSC2016 dataset and UCAS_AOD dataset.

articleTitle: Research on MAC Protocol Based on Terahertz Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the application prospects of terahertz networking technology in the future 6G, Internet of Things and ad hoc networks, this paper studies and designs a MAC protocol suitable for terahertz communication, and builds a hardware-in-the-loop system based on OPNET simulation software and FPGA. Finally, this paper verifies the access delay, throughput and other indicators of the system. Through verification, the MAC protocol can achieve access delay below 0.1s and throughput performance of nearly 1Gbps.

articleTitle: Research on COVID-19 document fine-grained classification based on graph neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Since the outbreak of COVID-19, academia has published tens of thousands of new papers. Facing so much literature knowledge, how to realize the fine-grained classification of covid-19 literature and help researchers carry out research? This is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper makes COVID-19 text classification graph data set, designs covid-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification model LC-GAT based on graph attention network, adds attention mechanism at word level, sentence level and graph level, effectively retains the classification information contained in article title and key words, and significantly improves the performance of covid-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification. This paper has positive significance for the classification of COVID-19 scientific literature.

articleTitle: Research on China’s OFDI Based on Big Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As an important means to extract valuable information from massive data, big data mining technical has been widely used in commercial and scientific research fields. In recent years, with the continuous acceleration of China’s globalization process, a large amount of OFDI data have emerged in business websites and related databases. Firstly, based on CiteSpace visualization software, this paper makes a bibliometric analysis of the research results of "China’s OFDI" in SSCI database and carries out text mining on the influencing factors of OFDI according to keywords co-occurrence network map and timezone map. Then, for further analyzing the factors affecting the survival of overseas subsidiaries, this paper uses R language web crawler technology to grab the list of overseas investment enterprises from the website of China’s Ministry of Commerce and constructs a small database of “going out” enterprises. Finally, the life table method and Cox proportional hazards regression model are used to make statistical and empirical analysis on the survival of overseas subsidiaries. The research shows the average survival duration of overseas subsidiaries is only 4.55 years, and the host country factors and the characteristics of the enterprises themselves will affect their long-term development.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Backbone Used for Scene Text Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper presents AutoMLPMixer which is a lightweight backbone based on the mixer-multi-layer percep-trons(MLPMixer) and automated machine learning. Secondly, in order to deal with parameter surging caused by a large dictionary in Chinese scene text recognition, this paper introduces grouped linear structure to process the embedding layers and prediction layers of the model. Compared with ResNet, the AutoMLPMixer can effectively reduce parameters by 16.4%. By introducing a grouped linear structure to solve the oversized dictionary problem, we can further reduce parameters by 14.89M in scene text recognition. Under coexist condition of both AutoMLPMixer and grouped linear structure, the model image processing speed increased by 29%. The code and models will be made publicly.

articleTitle: Design of student behavior characteristics analysis platform based on K-means clustering algorithm in local universities
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Student behavior characteristic data can fully reflect the behavior law of college students, which is of great significance to the educational management and decision-making of local universities. With the gradual acceleration of information construction in colleges and universities, most colleges and universities have developed the campus information management system. Facing the massive campus management data, how to effectively mine valuable information from it has become an important content to improve the level of student information management. This paper uses big data processing and analysis technology to comprehensively analyze the current big data of local universities. Moreover, a distributed computing platform based on K-means clustering algorithm is constructed based on the behavioral characteristics of college students, and a prediction model between student behavior and talent quality cultivation is constructed. This research can guide teaching management, student management, employment guidance and other related work in local universities.

articleTitle: Novel Nearest-Neighbor Data Association Algorithm with an Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the overlapping detection area of multiple millimeter-wave radars, the echo of a single target contains multiple radar measurement points. In the process of data fusion, these multiple homologous echo points need to be associated. In this paper, an adaptive threshold nearest neighbor data association (AT-NNDA) approach is proposed, which adds an adaptive association threshold judgment to the nearest neighbor algorithm, dedicated to solving the problem of multi-homolog echo point association. The proposed AT-NNDA is validated by collecting traffic scene data using smart vehicles equipped with multiple millimeter-wave radars. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional foxed-threshold nearest-neighbor association algorithm, the AT-NNDA algorithm can effectively correlate multiple echo points, with a low false correlation rate and of high practical value.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Grain Minimum Purchase Price Policy Based on Differences-in-Differences
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Since 2005, Chinese government has implemented a policy of minimun grain purchase prices, which has basically achieved the fundamental goal of stabilizing grain prices, promoting production and ensuring food security. In order to explore the influence of the minimum purchase price policy on China's grain industry, this paper takes wheat as an example to conduct empirical research and analysis. The sown area, yield and farmers' net income of 15 provinces from 2004 to 2021 were selected as explained variables to build a differences-in differences panel regression model . Use Python software to clean and filter the information of the big data. And in order to reduce dimension of big data information better, panel regression model is added principal component analysis. The results show that the minimum grain purchase price policy for grain production and grain planting area have a significant role in promoting, However, the improvement effect on rural residents'income is not significant. At the same time, suggestions were put forward to improve the domestic grain price system and lower the minimum grain purchase price , so as to continuously promote the healthy and sustainable development of the grain trading market and realize the goal of poverty alleviation and common prosperity at an early date.

articleTitle: Research and practice of big data modeling in asset management institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Domestic major asset management institutions (securities, funds, trusts, etc.) are speeding up the digital transformation, and the application of big data technology in asset management institutions is becoming more and more common. It is an important part of digital transformation to establish enterprise data model and describe all kinds of business objects comprehensively and logically. This paper researches the working method of big data modeling suitable for asset management institutions, and successfully applies it in practice, which can provide reference for other domestic asset management institutions.

articleTitle: RSSI Indoor Localization Method Base on RAUKF
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Location-based services(LBS) are widely applied in public safety, smart-hospital, industry and other scenarios recently. Demands of customer side presents many challenges for indoor positioning technology, such as accuracy, cost, power consumption, etc. Limited by the complexity of the indoor environment, the accuracy of the current applied in-door positioning system is relatively limited. Kalman filtering is a widely applied optimal estimation algorithm for linear systems, but it performs poorly for nonlinear systems. In the practical application of indoor positioning of kalman filter, the parameters affected by indoor environmental factors also restrict the positioning accuracy. In this paper we proposed an RSSI ranging-based indoor positioning algorithm, which fits the positioning results through the robust adaptive unscented kalman filter(RAUKF) to improve the positioning accuracy. An Singular Value Decomposition(SVD) method is deployed in the UKF to improve the numerical stability. The Root Main Square Error(RMSE) of 0.65m was achieved in MATLAB simulation experiment with four anchor nodes deployed.

articleTitle: A new method of constructing medical Chinese readability corpus based on big data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, a large amount of information appears in the world every day. The growth rate of information is absolutely a terrifying thing - we call it information explosion. However, due to the particularity of language teaching, students are often at a loss when facing texts of different levels, and it is difficult to choose articles suitable for their reading level. As the pillar of medical professional teaching, studying the teaching content and teaching difficulty of medical professional textbooks has become an important topic to improve medical professional teaching, to help international students enter the medical profession as soon as possible, and to carry out medical practice smoothly. However, there is a lack of scientific automatic construction method of medical Chinese (MC) readable corpus. We established Medical Chinese Textbook Corpus (MCTC), and it is divided into six categories with the help of repeated binary clustering (RBC). Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK) vocabulary and Medical Chinese Proficiency Test (MCT) vocabulary are used to measure the vocabulary proportion of each grade in the text. The experiment shows that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Time Series Traffic Analysis based on PCA and GMM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In modern traffic systems, traffic flow analysis in different areas is the key to traffic flow prediction. Because the traffic flow data is essentially time series data, which has the characteristics of large dimension and long duration, it is impossible to extract its distribution characteristics directly. The traditional methods based on linear regression, autoregression and gray prediction have low accuracy, while the methods based on deep learning have high computational complexity. PCA algorithm can effectively separate high-dimensional mixed data into low-dimensional separable data. Compared with other unsupervised clustering algorithms, Gaussian mixture model can better estimate the distribution of original data. Through the simulation and comparison of standard clustering algorithms, it is found that PCA and GMM algorithms have higher accuracy for traffic flow model estimation and are closer to the distribution characteristics of the original data.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Accident Emergency Plan Evaluation Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem of assessing the effectiveness of safety accident emergency plan, a hierarchical index system for evaluating safety accident emergency plan is established in terms of their scientific, relevance, completeness, operability and flexibility. The weight set of the index system is determined by AHP(analytic hierarchy process). On the basis of above, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is proposed to evaluate safety accident emergency plan in a qualitative and quantitative way, so as to provide a scientific and reasonable assessment of It provides technical support for scientific and reasonable evaluation of safety accident emergency plan.

articleTitle: Machine learning-based analysis of online course learning experience
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to timely and accurately reflect the learning experience in online learning and improve the course quality of online learning platform, the author selected the representative icourse163.org as the research object, and proposed a method based on machine learning for analyzing online course evaluation text. This method uses Scrapy framework of web crawler, Jieba Chinese word segmentation tool, Word2vec word vector conversion model, LDA topic model and other research tools, and uses TF-IDF algorithm. This analysis illustrate some problems existing in icourse163.org from three aspects of TF-IDF characteristic word frequency analysis, topic-keyword matrix and the proportion of negative evaluation topics. The results prove that the method proposed in this paper is of practical value. This method is expected to contribute to the development of online education.

articleTitle: Embedded front vehicle detection system based on fusion of machine learning and traditional methods
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: For the detection of remote and fuzzy small targets, machine learning detection has a higher probability of missed detection. It is more dangerous when applied to vehicle detection. Therefore, this paper proposes and uses a detection method that combines machine learning and traditional methods to deal with the problem that the vehicle in front with a high risk factor is missed. Through the designed prediction mechanism for fusion, the video frame images will be processed by different modules. Compared with target detection using machine learning only, the missed detection rate was reduced by 29.1%. Finally, we deploy it in an embedded device.

articleTitle: Monitoring and evaluation mechanism of power grid enterprise equipment based on IoT physical equipment code
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, the indicator system that can reflect the consistency, unity and authenticity of asset information, was constructed. The business process optimization related to the coding of physical equipment has been evaluated objectively and systematically. As well as the sharing and integration of asset-related information ware made. At the same time, the method of association analysis between asset equipment data and planning, enterprise operation, equipment suppliers, customers and other information, was made. the trend and law of enterprise operation and development, material supply, customer behavior analysis and other aspects ware developed to monitor. A decision support system based on equipment status data, cost, supplier information, fault information and other linkage data information is established to provide decision support for equipment status maintenance, supplier evaluation, material procurement and other work. As well as it supports for data authenticity and validity inspection under the asset management of power grid enterprises.

articleTitle: Gaussian Noise Removal Method Based on Empirical Wavelet Transform and Hypothesis Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Most industrial signals in reality have nonlinear and non-stationary characteristics, so the effect of signal denoising by general signal analysis methods is often not ideal. Taking the vibration signal of rolling bearing as an example, statistically, it is non Gaussian distribution, and the mixed noise is mostly Gaussian noise, and the noise bandwidth is wide, so the traditional filtering method is not suitable. Based on the above analysis, a Gaussian noise elimination method based on empirical wavelet transform and hypothesis test is proposed in this paper .Taking the vibration signal of rolling bearing as an example, Gaussian noise is mixed into it. The signal is decomposed into several components through empirical wavelet transform, and which components meet the Gaussian distribution are identified as noise through the hypothesis test of Gaussian distribution. The simulation results show that the denoising method proposed in this paper is more stable than the traditional method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Identifying Safety Risk
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Safety risk management is one of the important guarantees to ensure the safety of railway operation. The rapid development of Intelligent Transporation System (ITS) genereates large amounts of Multi-source heterogeneous data. Using traditional identification methods to identify safety risk of railway can not full fill with the needs of ITS. Knowledge driven safety risk management becomes an important direction in the development of ITS. In this paper, we propose a novel method to identify safety risk from textual data. Inspired by the knowledge graph of natural language processing community, we identify safety risk by relation extraction mode. In order to reduce the severe dependence on manual feature engineering, we adopt convolutional neural networks to automatically capture semantics of textual data. Then a softmax classifier is used to recognize the relation types. The experimental results on real dataset show that, our method achieves considerable performance and provides a novel direction to intelligent safety risk management.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Simulation Study of Wear-Leveling Block Searching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Phase Change Random Access Memory (PCRAM) is a promising non-volatile memory device due to its attractive properties such as low power, fast access time, high storage density and bit addressability. However, PCRAM suffers from its weakness in endurance. Wear-leveling algorithm research become one of the most important topics of PCRAM application. FPGA based MMU implementation is a bridge to connect IoT terminal MCU with PCRAM. Usage index based block searching algorithm is the most important and fundamental step in PCRAM wear-leveling algorithm implementation. Based on our previous research on the storage and computation integrated architecture of IoT terminal, this paper proposes a FPGA based simulation study on PCRAM wear-leveling block searching algorithm for the first time. High Level Synthesis (HLS) based experiments and algorithm simulations are carried out. Simulation results show that the proposed FPGA hardware block searching algorithm can be effectively implemented, thus, enables a better wear-leveling algorithm implementation to improve endurance of PCRAM in IoT terminal applications.

articleTitle: The Internet of Things(IoT) system for Bolt looseness detection in coal mines
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Intelligent industry was also called Industrial In-ternet of Things, which combines Internet of technology and traditional manufacturing modes, has played a positive role in Industrial production. Bolt connection plays an important role in coal mine machineries. A set of bolt looseness detection Internet of Things based on wireless Zigbee technology was designed in this article, and the three-dimensional finite element model of Hall sensor in COMSOL Multiphysics field is also established. We also design an installation method of the wireless Bolt Looseness sensor. ZigBee technology was adopted between end devices attached to bolts and the coordinator attached to bracket controller to establish a comprehensive monitoring platform conducive to timely decision-making and analysis. Hall sensors are deployed in the monitoring area in a certain number and scale, and the data monitored by sensor nodes are sent to the coordinator through wireless transmission. This sensor IoT system can detect bolt looseness in real time, which solves the problem that the large number of bolts to be monitored and difficulty in determining the position of looseness bolts.

Author Keywords: Bolt looseness detection in coal mines

articleTitle: Sign language recognition based on spatiotemporal convolutional neural network and attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Sign language recognition is an important technology for facilitating communication between deaf and hearing people in the field of computer vision. In view of the fact that the general 3D neural network model cannot achieve good recognition effect for video-level sign language and there are too many parameters, In this paper, a method based on the fusion of R(2+1)D network and attention mechanism is used to study the problem of isolated word sign language video recognition. First, the R (2+1)D network makes the network more expressive and easier to optimize by splitting the 3D convolutional structure into 2D plus 1D convolutions. On the other hand, the attention mechanism is integrated, which further enhances the feature extraction ability of the key actions in the sign language video of the network, and improves the recognition accuracy. The method adopted in this paper is trained and validated on the Chinese Sign Language Recognition dataset (CSL). The experimental results show that the method in this paper achieves better classification results in the sign language data samples extracted by CSL. Compared with the current mainstream methods, this method can further improve the accuracy of sign language recognition.

articleTitle: LSTM Molecular Descriptor-Free QSAR Application Research Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Traditional machine learning methods, especially random forests and support vector machines, can achieve good prediction accuracy in activity prediction, but the workload of screening molecular descriptors is too large and complicated. Therefore, this paper constructs and uses the QSAR model directly from the SMILES linear text representation of the compound, and uses the genetic algorithm-optimized long-short-term memory neural network model (GA-LSTM) to conduct quantitative structure-activity relationship analysis to predict human protein activity. The experimental results show that the accuracy and efficiency of the QSAR model without molecular descriptors based on GA-LSTM is higher than those of traditional machine learning methods, which provides a new idea and method for the pre-validation of drug development.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Improved Differential Evolution Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to deal with the changes of power flow distribution and topology caused by the incorporation of a large number of distributed generators into the distribution network, an improved differential evolution ant colony algorithm is proposed to reconstruct the distribution network with distributed generators. Firstly, in order to reduce the network loss, improve the load balance degree and obtain high-quality power, a distribution network reconfiguration model with network loss, load balance degree and voltage offset degree as the objective functions is constructed. Then, in view of the shortcomings of ant colony algorithm, such as slow searching speed, low flexibility, falling into local optimization and easy to fall into premature phenomenon, the improved differential evolution algorithm with linearly decreasing weight is combined with ant colony algorithm, so that the hybrid algorithm not only accelerates the convergence speed, effectively overcomes the premature phenomenon, but also improves the flexibility. Finally, by connecting the distributed generation to the IEEE 33 nodes system for example simulation, compared with other algorithms, it is found that the convergence speed and accuracy of the improved algorithm are significantly improved in the process of distribution network reconfiguration, and can be better used for distribution network reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Application of mobile terminal in ballastless track fine adjustment for high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to ensure the high smoothness of CRTS III slab ballastless track, the track slab must be fine adjusted after laying, so that the geometric shape and position of the track slab are consistent with the design theoretical position. The traditional track slab fine adjustment is realized based on industrial notebook, which is lack of portability and endurance, and the construction operation is not flexible. It is necessary to develop the track slab fine adjustment software based on the wireless transmission mode of mobile terminal.The software is developed based on the mobile terminal and Android platform, uses GeoCom communication technology to open up the control interface with the measuring robot, realizes wireless communication and automatic control with the measuring robot, opens up the interface with the construction layout software, realizes the automatic calculation of fine adjustment deviation, and completes the wireless upload of fine adjustment results to the track slab fine adjustment information platform. The software realizes the fine adjustment of track slab under wireless control mode, effectively improves the measurement efficiency and ensures the fine adjustment quality of ballastless track slab.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Tracking Control of Wheeled Mobile Robot by ILC
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, Back-stepping and ILC(Iterative Learning Control) in trajectory tracking algorithms are compared. Firstly, the kinematic model of 4WID-4WIS mobile robot is established, and then Back-stepping and ILC are used to complete the control respectively. Finally, simulation results show that ILC can achieve better control accuracy than Back-stepping without precise model and complex parameter adjustment.

articleTitle: Visual localization of underwater obstacles based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the progress of computer technology, intelligent vehicles have developed rapidly and are widely used in national defense, scientific research, daily life and other fields. Among them, obstacle detection is the core problem of intelligent vehicle navigation. Convolutional Neural Network is a kind of feedforward network. Its artificial neurons can respond to the units within the coverage, including convolution layer and pooling layer, which has excellent performance in image processing. In response to the problem of inaccurate and poor robustness of traditional underwater disorder detection algorithms, this article proposes a kind of underwater obstacle detection algorithm based on Convolutional Neural Networks. which can accurately identify underwater obstacles and non-obstacles. These traditional ways have the shortcomings of low scientific and technological content, simple function and limited detection. In order to make the blind travel safely and conveniently, this paper studies the intelligent blind guidance system. Because the traditional machine learning algorithm needs to extract a large number of features manually, the training is time-consuming and laborious, and it is difficult to meet the real-time detection of the target. The system is composed of image acquisition module and obstacle detection module. The image acquisition module collects binocular images and transmits them to the obstacle detection module to process the collected image data and obtain accurate obstacle areas. The detection method performs median filtering on the collected original image. The binocular image is corrected according to the camera parameters. A new convolution kernel is designed and applied to convolution neural network structure to generate accurate disparity map. The improved Convolutional Neural Network is based on the original network, adjusting the convolution, adjusting the size and number of the convolutional kernel, the size of the pooling layer space, and the depth of the neural network, by increasing the pooling layer of the convolution layer, to increase the recognition rate of obstacles.

articleTitle: Study on cycle-by-cycle variation in a homogeneous charge compression ignition engine fueled with n-butanol/diesel blends
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to improve the combustion stability of homogeneous charge compression ignition engines fueled with n-butanol/diesel blends, the effect of blending ratio, intake charge temperature and excess air ratio on the cycle-by-cycle variation in peak in-cylinder pressure were analyzed. Experimental results show that, with increase of the blending ratio, the coefficient of variation in peak in-cylinder pressure reduces first and then increases. With increase in temperature of intake charge, the mean value of peak in-cylinder pressure rises sharply while the coefficient of variation in peak in-cylinder pressure decreases obviously. With increase in excess air ratio, the mean value of peak in-cylinder pressure reduces sharply while the coefficient of variation in peak in-cylinder pressure increases obviously.

articleTitle: Chinese Medical Word Embedding Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Word embedding has been successfully applied to Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we learn Chinese medical word embeddings in different ways and use the same corpus to evaluate the quality of the word embeddings. Firstly, we perform word embedding training through target domain data combined with data from different domains to achieve word embedding sharing and enrich the semantic information of word embeddings; Secondly, static word embedding and dynamic word embedding are combined to solve semantic ambiguity by adding dynamic word embedding. Finally, word embedding sharing combined with parameter migration is used to reduce the use of training data and adjust word embedding. Furthermore, we evaluate the quality of word embeddings obtained by different models through three metrics: word analogy, word embedding visualization, and named entity recognition task. By comparing the quality of word embedding in different models, we found that our proposed method improved in each evaluation result.

articleTitle: Key technology of intelligent efficient quantitative loading system
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In view of the current situation that the intelligent level of the existing rapid quantitative loading system is not high, and the loading process depends on the experience of the loaders, this paper studies the key technologies to realize the intellectualization of the rapid quantitative loading system. The project develops a multi-dimensional perception system of loading process based on radar, combined grating, video capture and RFID and develops an intelligent control system based on machine learning, which realizes the self-adaptive unmanned loading with different material characteristics and vehicle status.

articleTitle: Improving Mirror Fitness through augmented reality technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Along with the development of sports in the new China, the whole country is actively responding to the national call for a "Healthy China", the fitness industry is booming, and people's physical quality and health levels are improving. The latter situation has brought new opportunities and challenges to fitness, and smart fitness has become an unstoppable trend. Taking the more prominent Mirror Fitness as the research object, it is found that its action error correction feedback is defective and only reminds users in the form of text, which reduces the efficiency of exercise. This paper combines the concept and technology of augmented reality, and researches combining it with the user's mirror image to intuitively reflect the incorrect action area through virtual-real interaction, allowing the user to receive information and correct it in time, which not only reduces exercise risk but also improves exercise efficiency and user experience.

articleTitle: Distributed Semi-Supervised Learning with Positive and Unlabeled Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Due to the prejudicial interest on positive aspect and/or absent of negative training data on some applications, positive and unlabeled learning (PU learning) has attracted much attention. However, all of the existing PU learning algorithms belong to centralized processing. Yet, in many real-world scenarios, data are usually collected and stored over multiple nodes with restriction of geographic factors or memory space. Considering this, in this paper, we focus on distributed classification with positive and unlabeled data, and propose a distributed PU learning algorithm based on Semi-Supervised Support Vector Machine (dPU-S<sup>3</sup>VM). To exploit the underlying information in the unlabeled data, the manifold regularization is incorporated into the design of the cost function. Furthermore, the random feature map is used for mapping the original data to high dimensional kernel space such that the global optimization problem can be decentralized without the direct transmission of the original data. The convergence performance of the proposed dPU-S<sup>3</sup>VM algorithm is analyzed theoretically. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has better classification performance than the state-of-the-art PU learning algorithms on various synthetic and real-world datasets especially when the portion of labeled positive examples is small.
