articleTitle: Application of computer virtual simulation technology in tourism industry
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, China has made great achievements in artificial intelligence and computer virtual simulation technology. On the basis of introducing the characteristics and advantages of computer virtual simulation technology, this paper analyzes and studies the current situation of the application of virtual simulation technology in China's tourism industry under the platform of intelligent tourism, and the necessity of research on the integration development of VR and tourism. It also discusses the application of computer simulation technology in China's tourism industry, and puts forward how to further integrate VR virtual reality technology and tourism industry under the background of intelligent tourism, to realize virtual tourism and broaden the development path of "virtual + tourism" suggestions and prospects.

articleTitle: A Named Entity Recognition Method For Chinese Winter Sports News Based On RoBERTa-WWM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the task of Named Entity Recognition (NER) of winter sports text news, for the problem that common Pre-trained Language Model (PLM)trained with a common corpus have limited semantic representation capabilities for sentence and words in the winter sports domain, and the problem that Chinese BERT PLM, trained based on a single character masking approach, cannot understand Chinese semantic features well, this paper proposes a Named Entity Recognition method for Chinese winter sports news based on RoBERTa-WWM model. Firstly, we add many proper nouns and terminologies in the domain of winter sports to lexicon of the LTP word segmentation tool used for pre-training of RoBERTa-WWM model, so that the LTP can segment the text more accurately, thus the RoBERTa-WWM model can achieve more accurate Whole Word Masking (WWM) pre-training. After that, we pre-train the RoBERTa-WWM model on abundant unlabeled winter sports text news data with the premise of more accurate WWM pre-training. In the end, the pre-trained RoBERTa-WWM model is used as the word embedding layer to connect with the downstream task model BILSTM-CRF for fine-tuning the NER task by using a hierarchical learning approach, to obtain better accuracy of entity recognition results. The experimental results show that the NER model trained by the method proposed in this paper achieves an F1 value of 93.56% in the NER test of actual winter sports textual news, which is 0.77% higher than the F1 value of the common RoBERTa-WWM-BiLSTM-CRF model, 1.81% higher than the F1 value of the common BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model, and 4.88% higher than the F1 value of the BiLSTM-CRF benchmark model.

articleTitle: Blockchain abnormal transaction detection method based on weighted sampling neighborhood nodes
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In view of the increasingly serious problem of money laundering crime in the blockchain industry, the existing solutions in this scenario can not be applied to reality, or there is a high false positive rate and false negative rate, a method based on weighted sampling neighborhood nodes is designed to find and analyze the implied interrelationship in the data between blockchain transaction features, and learn more effective aggregate input features in the local neighborhood of nodes through model training. Good results have been achieved on the public data set, which verifies the effectiveness of the model in the field of blockchain abnormal transaction detection. Moreover, it provides an idea of modelling transaction entity data by using graph neural network structure for the field of financial data transactions such as anti-money laundering monitoring.

articleTitle: Traffic prediction of converged network for smart gird based on GNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Smart grid is one of the representative applications for 5G network. However, at the current stage, it is difficult for 5G network to achieve full coverage while power private LTE-G 230 wireless network has the characteristics of wide coverage and low operating costs. Therefore, it is more meaningful to integrate 5G and power private LTE-G 230 wireless network to cope with the current situation. Traffic predication of the converged network can provide support for network resource allocation and optimization. This paper proposes a method for traffic prediction of the converged network for smart grid. First, the processing center of smart grid collects feature data related to 5G transmission of terminals through power private LTE-G 230 wireless network, including terminal location distribution, bandwidth requirements, actual bandwidth, and communication quality. Secondly, using the collected sequence of the feature data as input, the deep learning framework GNN and LSTM are adopted to predict the traffic demand of the base station in the next stage. Among them, GNN is used to model the spatial correlation of adjacent base stations in the topology map, while LSTM is used to model the temporal correlation of sequence data. In the experiments, we simulated three types of power services and further generated the feature data for base station. The experimental results verified the effectiveness of the proposed method and it can achieve high accuracy of predication.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Design of Windows Cleaning Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: It is imperative to maintain a clean living and working environment. As a result of the development of the construction industry, high-rise buildings are now ubiquitous. Traditional methods of cleaning are insufficient to maintain these buildings. Considering tall buildings can be more than 100 meters above ground level, airflow speeds are greater, and protection devices are essential. Additionally, manual cleaning is slower, and accidents are more likely. Consequently, the use of automatic cleaning robots is crucial to replacing manual cleaning. Further, automatic cleaning robots have the stability and accuracy that manual cleaning does not possess. Robots are more efficient at cleaning than humans. Three different types of cleaning robot mechanisms are discussed, including adsorption mechanisms, motion mechanisms, and cleaning mechanisms, and their application areas and advantages and disadvantages are compared. In the next section, we summarize the results of comparing the various types of mechanical engineering used in the adsorption device, the motion mechanism, and the cleaning device. The evaluation concludes with an assessment of the shortcomings and recommendations for future research. A number of types of automatic window cleaning robots are presented to the reader as references.

articleTitle: PCIe device drivers in Linux : Design and implementation of a high-speed PCI Express bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this design we will implement a bridge that enables communication with hardware that does not have native PCI Express support. The bridge should convert PCI Express to Low Voltage Differential Signaling (LVDS) and/or CMOS-logic. LVDS and CMOS covers the most frequently used solutions for communicating between different hardware; differential and single-ended. Furthermore, the (CMOS/LVDS) side should be easily reconfigurable in order to support different types, amounts and combinations of interfaces. The design should be able to interface with at least a PCI Express Gen1 x2 interface, meaning that there are two data lanes at 2.5 GT/s. Later generations are desirable but not necessary. The lane configuration (x2) must not change. The design should act as a PCI Express endpoint. The interface should be able to support both LVDS and CMOS interfaces. The number of interfaces should be configurable to suit the application. Furthermore, each interface should be able to transmit data at up to 150 MHz <sup>[10]</sup>.

articleTitle: Technology Analysis of Network Anomalous Behavior Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the increasingly changing network environment, network anomalous behaviors show a trend of concealment and complexity, and it is crucial to detect anomalous behaviors and eliminate hidden dangers to enhance network system security. Researchers have applied machine learning methods to anomaly detection and achieved good results. This paper presents a review of these studies. First, the concept of anomalous behavior, its sources and its analysis methods are introduced, and then an overview of the application of machine learning methods is given, detailing in order the commonly used datasets, data pre-processing methods and the application of machine learning in anomaly detection. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of different methods are summarized, and the main challenges and solution ideas faced in the current anomaly detection tasks are analyzed.

articleTitle: Multi-attention mechanism news recommendation model with fused entity features
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Existing news recommendation methods often do not sufficiently mine news fine-grained features, resulting in modeled news vectors that often do not accurately represent news. To address this problem, a multi-attention mechanism news recommendation model with fused entity features is proposed. The model is based on multi-head attention mechanism and additive attention mechanism, and uses news content entities to represent news content, deeply fusing and mining the intrinsic connection of fine-grained features such as news title, news categories, and news content. Additionally, in order to accurately model user preferences, activation units are introduced to adaptively learn vector representations of user interests from candidate news and users' recently viewed news. The experimental results of the dataset MIND show that the model has different degrees of improvement in the evaluation metrics AUC, MRR and nDCG compared with other news recommendation models.

articleTitle: Research on industrial robot sorting technology based on binocular vision
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the development of robotics and machine vision technology, the introduction of vision technology has further improved the intelligence and autonomy of robots. At present, most of the sorting systems based on industrial robots are oriented to the structured working environment, and the sorting objects are single and inefficient. In order to enable industrial robots to complete the sorting task of multi-class workpieces in unstructured environment, this paper studies the industrial robot sorting system based on binocular vision and its key technologies<sup>[1]</sup>.This paper mainly studies the industrial robot sorting system based on binocular vision and the key technologies involved. The hardware platform of the sorting system is built with six degrees of freedom AuBO-I5 industrial robot, PC, industrial camera, pneumatic fixture and parallel light source. In the hybrid development environment built by VS2017, Qt and ALCON, the software platform of the sorting system was developed, and the task of the robot sorting the workpiece was finally completed. This paper mainly includes four parts. Firstly, the overall system design and hardware selection are carried out according to the task requirements, and the kinematics analysis of AuBO-I5 industrial robot is completed. Secondly, the binocular vision system and the hand-eye system are studied, the transformation relationship between pixel coordinate system and robot base coordinate system is obtained, and the binocular image is preprocessed<sup>[2]</sup>.Then, the stereo matching algorithm based on improved Census transform and gradient fusion is studied and binocular stereo matching is performed to obtain the disparity map of binocular images. Finally, the template matching technology is used to identify the class of the workpiece, and the 3D reconstruction and pose detection of the grasping point of the workpiece are carried out<sup>[3]</sup>. The upper computer interface is programmed to realize the sorting function of the system.

articleTitle: Driving Behavior Identification of Operating Vehicles Based on Real-Time Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Trajectory data of operating vehicles contains abundant spatiotemporal information about driving behaviors. With the development of big data processing and mode identification techniques, these methods can be used to mine the patterns of driving behaviors from the trajectory data, and compensate the disadvantages of visual image analysis results. In this research, the trajectory data is partitioned by reactive greedy randomized adaptive search procedure into small segments, and driving behavior on the segments is identified by gated recurrent unit neural network model. The proposed method is verified by real-time trajectory data from Chongqing and Shanghai with over 370000 trajectory points, and the result shows that the accuracy of identifying operating vehicles’ driving behavior has reached 91.57%, which indicates that the proposed method improves performances in dealing with large scale trajectory data. This could be used to enhance the supervision on operating vehicles’ safety for transportation companies as well as transportation management departments, and improve operating vehicles transportation management strategies.

articleTitle: QuatCNNEx: A Knowledge Graph Embedding Model based on Quaternion Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: We can infer the missing links in the Knowledge Graph from the known knowledge when the existing Knowledge Graph is incomplete. Knowledge Graph Embedding is a common method to solve this kind of problem, that is, using low dimensional embedding of entities and relations to infer the missing links. The existing Knowledge Graph Embedding methods either do not make full use of the interactive feature information of entities and relations or have weak modeling ability for composition relation. Therefore, the combination of quaternion and convolution neural network is explored to construct QuatCNNEx which is a new Knowledge Graph Embedding model. The quaternion used in the model encodes the triple of Knowledge Graph, the quaternion embedding of entities and relations are used to the input of convolution neural network, and the model combines the Hadamard product of quaternion to predict the missing links in Knowledge Graph. The results of the experiment show that QuatCNNEx can model the composition relations and predict the missing triples in the Knowledge Graph using the interactive feature information of entities and relations.

articleTitle: Visualization and Scoring Models : Trending Videos Discovery and Recommendation based on Information Entropy Method and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Many studies about the YouTube company’s business model analysis are based on data grasped from the YouTube platform. However, few studies are related to the updated trending videos on the YouTube platform with respect to different countries or regions. This article is to analyze the different characteristics of YouTube trending videos in each country or region by studying the characteristics of YouTube trending videos in six representative countries or regions and then apply Information Entropy Method and Principal Component Analysis for the datasets and select the truly popular categories among the huge datasets. Our findings contribute to some existing YouTube reports and improve on the updating data, differences among countries, and numerical ways for analysis.

articleTitle: An analysis method of industrial data relationship based on business context
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Industrial big data processing is an important support for improving industrial production efficiency. Because industrial big data involves complex business logic in production scenarios, there is a widespread problem that the relationship between data is difficult to understand. Therefore, this paper proposes a relational analysis method of industrial data based on business context. Firstly, a semantic data dictionary is established according to the production business process, and then a data object recognition model based on deep learning is trained; then a context-based automatic association method of industrial data relations is proposed; finally, the experimental verification is carried out on the actual production data, and the results show that The method in this paper is effective in improving the relationship analysis of industrial data.

articleTitle: Pedestrian re-identification based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: At present, most mainstream pedestrian re-identification(ReID) methods are based on convolution neural network(CNN). However, CNN has the problems of information loss caused by down-sampling algorithm and remote dependence modeling. Transformer architecture has achieved good performance in various visual tasks recently. In order to explore its ability in ReID task, we designed a ReID model based on Swin Transformer architecture, and improve it by combining multi-scale feature fusion. Specifically, Swin Transformer is used as a backbone network to extract image features, and design two modules to enhance feature perception. (1) Shallow feature extraction module (SFE) is embedded in the initial position of the model to generate robust shallow feature expression. (2) Multi-scale feature fusion module (MFM) extracts signs from different stages of the model, and further enhances the feature extraction ability of the model by fusing different levels of features. Based on experimental results, the proposed model based on Swin Transformer achieves a higher recognition accuracy than the mainstream CNN-based pedestrian re-identification method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Voice Agent: The Impact of Vocal Pitch on Customer Purchase Behavior in Voice Shopping
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Although voice shopping has gradually become an effective e-commerce channel, research on how intelligent voice agent’s vocal pitch affects customer purchase behavior is still limited. This study explored how intelligent voice agent’s vocal pitch impacts customer purchase behavior by 2 (high-/low-pitched) × 2 (feminine/masculine intelligent voice agent) laboratory experiments analyses. Results indicate that vocal pitch significantly impacts customer purchase behavior, for feminine intelligent voice agent, but not for masculine. The underlying mechanisms reveal that feminine intelligent voice agent’s high-pitched voice increases customers’ pleasure and engagement, which not only offsets the decreased trust caused by the high vocal pitch, but promotes customer purchase behavior. Additionally, customers’ gender moderates the impact of vocal pitch on purchase behavior. Based on the findings, we provided useful insights for the understanding of the effectiveness of intelligent voice agent’s voice pitch and voice shopping.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo Tree Search: A Survey of Theories and Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a state-of-the-art family of algorithms that combine Monte Carlo evaluations with tree search. It is attracting more and more interest due to its great success in the Grand Challenge of computer Go, and it has been proven effective in various other decision-making scenarios. This paper is a survey of the literatures to date, aims to make a comprehensive overview of the background history, basic theory, and applications in various fields of MCTS. We outline variants and policy enhancement techniques that have been proposed, these make MCTS applicable to more kinds of scenarios. Finally we point out that the use of MCTS is still a great challenge in realtime scenarios, most of which have imperfect information.

articleTitle: Evaluation Metrics for Hierarchical Multi-label Text Classification: Combining Structural and Semantic Features
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: For hierarchical multi-label classification tasks, performance measures play a critical role in model selection and evaluation, which are complicated by the rich hierarchical structure. Several evaluation measures have been proposed without however taking both semantic similarity and hierarchical structure into account. Thus, this study reviews the use of hierarchical measures previously mentioned in academia and introduces a new metric that considers both hierarchical structure features and category semantic features. We demonstrate the efficacy of this metric in terms of consistency and discriminancy.

articleTitle: Maintenance of Shanghai Actual Population Data Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: At present, there are problems of untimely and inaccurate data updating in the actual population database in Shanghai. The specific manifestation is that there are a large number of people in Shanghai but not registered (referred to as missing registration) and people who have left Shanghai but the information has not been canceled from the actual population database (referred to as not canceled). In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes to build a data warehouse based on the continuously updated population big data and the existing actual population database to update the actual population database in time. Firstly, the paper use Kettle to process the acquired data source and load the suspicious person data (suspected unregistered or suspected uncanceled) from the data source into the data warehouse by comparing it with the registered data in the actual population database. Then, a data fusion algorithm is proposed to fuse and analyze the data in the data warehouse, and analyze the high-suspected unregistered personnel and the high-suspected unregistered personnel to update the Shanghai actual population database in time. This provides support for maintaining accurate and real-time population databases and solves the problem of inaccurate data in the real population database to a certain extent.

articleTitle: FusionNet: a New Perspective of CNN for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The civil livelihood plan is related to corn, or maize, as one of the most significant grain products that suffers from various kinds of diseases, resulting in a decline in production. Traditional manual examination for disease in terms of prevention and control is time-consuming with low efficiency. Therefore, this paper proposes a new architecture called FusionNet fully based on deep convolution network to improve the speed and accuracy of the classification of various maize diseases. Using focus splitting, identity shortcut, and multi-feature channel fusion, this model presents a new consideration of larger kernels utilized in concatenated for features that offer more effective receptive fields to facilitate the reduction of reused redundancy, especially for middle-layer abstract information, which could compensate for the shortage of feature selectivity of CNN. Moreover, the total number of parameters is limited by depth-wise(DW) convolutions. The validity of the model is demonstrated on modified PlantVillage and PlantDoc datasets, achieving an accuracy of 94.9% on average.

articleTitle: Entity relationship extraction model based on entity information enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The entity-relationship extraction task consists of name entity recognition and relationship classification. To address the problem that the current entity-relationship extraction task in the Chinese language domain does not fully utilized the relevant information of entities, we propose a relationship extraction model based on entity information enhancement, using entity category information to construct entity category labels to enrich the original text data, adding the labeled vocabulary as a priori information to the word list of the pre-trained model. At the same time, entity information is considered a kind of crucial information in the relationship extraction task, so this paper increases the entity information in the input data to enhance the model’s ability to process the critical information of the task. Two sub-experiments, entity recognition and relationship classification, are constructed in the form of a Pipeline, where the relationship classification task exists as a downstream task of entity recognition. The model is trained and tested on the DuIE dataset. The results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed model for entity-relationship in the Chinese domain.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Graph Modeling Method for Financial Audit of Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, the financial audit of power grid enterprises has become one of the important components of the economic supervision system. This paper proposes a knowledge graph modeling method for the internal audit of power grid enterprises, and uses deep learning technology to mine the causal relationship between structured data and unstructured data. Knowledge graph makes audit data easier to understand by structurally describing concepts, entities and their relationships in objective data information. With the advantage of knowledge graph semantic network, it can effectively mine the hidden value of massive audit data and the correlation between data. At the same time, the deep learning technology is introduced into the knowledge graph component to extract data features from the multivariate and heterogeneous data of the audit system and mine the relationship between data, which can effectively improve the internal audit level of enterprises.On the basis of previous theoretical work, this paper proposes a set of knowledge graph construction algorithm based on deep learning, and through the comparison with the knowledge graph based on relationship detection, it is verified by experiments that the proposed method has the advantages of large amount of information recognition and high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Cost-sensitive Learning for Wheat Frost Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Frost damage is one of the main factors leading to wheat yield reduction. Therefore, the detection of wheat frost accurately and efficiently is beneficial for growers to take corresponding measures in time to reduce economic loss. To detect the wheat frost, in this paper we create a hyperspectral wheat frost data set by collecting the data characterized by temperature, wheat yield, and hyperspectral information provided by the handheld hyperspectral spectrometer. However, due to the imbalance of data, that is, the number of healthy samples is much higher than the number of frost damage samples, a deep learning algorithm tends to predict biasedly towards the healthy samples resulting in model overfitting of the healthy samples. Therefore, we propose a method based on deep cost-sensitive learning, which uses a one-dimensional convolutional neural network as the basic framework and incorporates cost-sensitive learning with fixed factors and adjustment factors into the loss function to train the network. Meanwhile, the accuracy and F<inf>1</inf> score are used as evaluation metrics. Experimental results show that the detection accuracy and the F<inf>1</inf> score reached 0.943 and 0.623 respectively, this demonstration shows that this method not only ensures the overall accuracy but also effectively improves the detection rate of frost samples.
